requirement.text: The system SHALL require two-factor authentication for any user signing in from an IP address outside the clinical VLAN range, and SHALL grant access only after a valid second factor is supplied.

test_cases.description: Verify two-factor authentication is required and grants access from an external IP.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in two-factor authentication; workstation IP outside the clinical VLAN range.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. From an IP outside the clinical VLAN range, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter a valid second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The source IP is recognised as outside the clinical VLAN range and a two-factor authentication challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The valid second factor is accepted and access is granted.

test_cases.description: Verify an invalid second factor denies access.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in two-factor authentication; workstation IP outside the clinical VLAN range.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. From an IP outside the clinical VLAN range, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter an INVALID second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A two-factor authentication challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The invalid second factor is rejected and access is denied.

requirement.text: The system SHALL archive vital-sign readings older than 30 days to cold storage and SHALL keep archived readings retrievable within 10 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify readings older than 30 days are archived to cold storage and remain retrievable.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Locate a vital-sign reading dated 60 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier and open it.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is reported as held in cold storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. Its values are retrieved and displayed within 10 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify readings newer than 30 days are not archived to cold storage.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Locate a vital-sign reading dated 1 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is listed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The reading is in active storage and has not been archived to cold storage.

test_cases.description: Verify the 30-day archival boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Inspect a reading dated exactly 30 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect a reading dated exactly 31 days ago.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 30 days the reading is still in active storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 31 days the reading has been archived to cold storage.

requirement.text: The system SHALL let a nurse document a medication administration of Insulin lispro 4 units, SHALL capture the administration time, and SHALL block a duplicate medication administration within 15 minutes of the previous one for the same medication.

test_cases.description: Verify a nurse can document a medication administration of Insulin lispro 4 units.

Step: 2. Select the active Insulin lispro 4 units order and document the administration.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Medication Administration Record is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The medication administration is documented and Insulin lispro 4 units is shown as administered.

test_cases.description: Verify a duplicate medication administration within 15 minutes is blocked.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Insulin lispro 4 units.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Given Insulin lispro 4 units was administered 5 minutes ago, select the same order.
Step: 2. Attempt a second administration and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Insulin lispro 4 units order is selectable.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 15 minutes the administration is accepted.

test_cases.description: Verify the administration time is captured and persisted.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Insulin lispro 4 units.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Document a medication administration and open the recorded entry.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded entry stores the administration time.

requirement.text: The system SHALL deliver a critical lab value notification for hemoglobin to the ordering provider's secure inbox within 5 minutes of result verification.

test_cases.description: Verify the 5-minute delivery boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding hemoglobin order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical hemoglobin result and measure delivery latency to the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is recorded as delivered within 5 minutes of verification.

test_cases.description: Verify the notification routes to the ordering provider specifically.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding hemoglobin order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical hemoglobin result ordered by 'dr.t' and inspect the recipient.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is routed to the ordering provider's secure inbox, not to any other recipient.

requirement.text: The system SHALL transmit a signed prescription to the selected pharmacy within 60 seconds of signing and SHALL update the order status to 'Sent' upon receiving pharmacy confirmation.

test_cases.description: Verify a signed prescription is transmitted to the selected pharmacy.

test_cases.description: Verify status does not become 'Sent' when the pharmacy is unreachable.

test_cases.description: Verify the order status updates to 'Sent' upon pharmacy confirmation.

test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Transmit a prescription and have the pharmacy return confirmation.

requirement.text:
The system SHALL display the pulse pressure computed from systolic and diastolic blood pressure on the patient header, rounded to 0 decimal place(s).

test_cases.description: Verify pulse pressure is computed from systolic and diastolic blood pressure and displayed.

test_cases.description: Verify the displayed pulse pressure is rounded to 0 decimal place(s).

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 3 consecutive failed login attempts within a 30-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

test_cases.description: Verify the account locks after 3 consecutive failed logins within 30 minutes.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t330' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 3 consecutive failed login attempts for 'user.t330' within 30 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt a further login using the CORRECT password.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the 3th consecutive failure the account is locked.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied despite correct credentials and a lockout notice naming the account and lockout duration is shown.

test_cases.description: Verify a successful login before the threshold resets the counter.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t330' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 2 failed attempts, then log in with the correct password.
Step: 2. Log out and submit 2 further failed attempts.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the correct login the failed-attempt counter resets to 0.
ExpectedResult: 2. The account remains unlocked and no lockout notice appears, because no window contains 3 consecutive failures.

test_cases.description: Verify the 3-attempt / 30-minute boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t330' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit exactly 2 failed attempts within 30 minutes and inspect state.
Step: 2. Submit an 3th failed attempt at minute 29 and inspect state.
Step: 3. For a fresh account submit 2 failures, wait past minute 30, then submit one more.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 2 failures the account remains unlocked.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 3 failures within 30 minutes the account locks and the lockout notice appears.
ExpectedResult: 3. The final failure falls outside the 30-minute window, so the account remains unlocked.

requirement.text: The system SHALL automatically end a clinical session after 20 minutes without user input and SHALL require re-authentication before the chart can be accessed again.

test_cases.description: Verify a session ends after 20 minutes of no input and requires re-authentication.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx20' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 20 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient chart and leave the workstation idle for 20 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt to scroll the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 20 minutes of inactivity the session ends and the chart is hidden.
ExpectedResult: 2. The chart is inaccessible and a re-authentication prompt is displayed; access is restored only after valid credentials.

test_cases.description: Verify input before the timeout keeps the session active.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx20' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 20 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for 19 minutes, then click within the chart.
Step: 2. Remain idle for a further 19 minutes, then click within the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The session remains active and no prompt appears.
ExpectedResult: 2. The session remains active because each input resets the inactivity timer.

requirement.text: The system SHALL alert the ordering provider when two active medications (Simvastatin and Clarithromycin) have a known major drug-drug interaction, and the alert SHALL name both interacting medications.

test_cases.description: Verify a major drug-drug interaction alert is raised naming both medications.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Simvastatin + Clarithromycin as a major interaction.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm Simvastatin is active for the test patient.
Step: 2. Order and sign Clarithromycin for the patient.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Simvastatin is shown as active.
ExpectedResult: 2. A major drug-drug interaction alert is presented and the alert text names both Simvastatin and Clarithromycin.

test_cases.description: Verify no alert is raised for a non-interacting pair.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Simvastatin + Clarithromycin as a major interaction.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm the patient has an active medication with no known interaction with the ordered drug.
Step: 2. Order and sign a non-interacting medication.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The prior medication is active.
ExpectedResult: 2. The order is signed with no drug-drug interaction alert presented.

test_cases.description: Verify the drug-drug interaction alert text names both interacting medications.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Simvastatin + Clarithromycin as a major interaction.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Trigger the Simvastatin + Clarithromycin interaction and inspect the alert text.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The alert text explicitly contains both 'Simvastatin' and 'Clarithromycin' by name.

requirement.text: The system SHALL restrict access to substance-use treatment notes to users holding the Addiction Medicine role and SHALL deny access to all other roles, recording each denied attempt in the audit log.

test_cases.description: Verify a Addiction Medicine role holder can open a substance-use treatment notes record.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'auth.t' holds the Addiction Medicine role; a substance-use treatment notes record exists for the test patient.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Log in as a user holding the Addiction Medicine role.
Step: 2. Open the patient's substance-use treatment notes.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Addiction Medicine role is active.
ExpectedResult: 2. The substance-use treatment notes opens and its content is displayed.

test_cases.description: Verify a user without the Addiction Medicine role is denied access.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'auth.t' holds the Addiction Medicine role; a substance-use treatment notes record exists for the test patient.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Log in as a user WITHOUT the Addiction Medicine role.
Step: 2. Attempt to open the substance-use treatment notes.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Login succeeds without the Addiction Medicine role.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied and no substance-use treatment notes content is displayed.

requirement.text: The system SHALL calculate a Acetaminophen dose as 15 milligrams per kilogram of the patient's recorded body weight and SHALL round the calculated dose to 1 decimal place(s).

test_cases.description: Verify the Acetaminophen dose is calculated as 15 mg/kg of recorded body weight.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Acetaminophen dosing is 15 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm the recorded body weight is 12.0 kg.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Acetaminophen dosing at 15 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded body weight of 12.0 kg is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The system calculates and displays a dose of 180.0 mg.

test_cases.description: Verify calculation is blocked when no recorded body weight is recorded.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Acetaminophen dosing is 15 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient with NO recorded body weight.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Acetaminophen dosing at 15 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The chart shows no recorded body weight.
ExpectedResult: 2. No dose is calculated; an error states a recorded weight is required and the order cannot be signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the calculated dose is rounded to 1 decimal place(s).
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Acetaminophen dosing is 15 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Set the recorded body weight to 12.345 kg and select 15 mg/kg dosing.
Step: 2. Set the recorded body weight to 12.344 kg and repeat.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The displayed dose is 185.2 mg, rounded to 1 decimal place(s).
ExpectedResult: 2. The displayed dose shows no more than 1 decimal place(s).

requirement.text: The system SHALL require a documented override reason of at least 8 characters when a provider dismisses a duplicate-therapy alert, and SHALL store the override reason with the order.

test_cases.description: Verify a duplicate-therapy alert can be dismissed with a sufficient override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a duplicate-therapy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the duplicate-therapy alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of at least 8 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The duplicate-therapy alert is presented and a override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is accepted and the order is signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the alert cannot be dismissed with no override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a duplicate-therapy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the duplicate-therapy alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Leave the override reason empty and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is rejected, a message requires a override reason, and the order is not signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 8-character minimum override reason boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a duplicate-therapy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Enter a override reason of 7 characters and confirm.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of exactly 8 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 7 characters the override is rejected, below the 8-character minimum.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 8 characters the override is accepted.

test_cases.description: Verify the accepted override reason is stored with the order.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a duplicate-therapy alert.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Dismiss the duplicate-therapy alert with a valid override reason and open the signed order detail.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The stored order detail shows the exact override reason text that was entered.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a new patient registration when the supplied medical record number (MRN-D) already exists in the system, and SHALL display the conflicting medical record number in the rejection message.

test_cases.description: Verify a new patient can be registered with a unique medical record number.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The registration form is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The patient is registered and the chart is created with medical record number 'MRN-D-0001'.

test_cases.description: Verify registration is rejected when the medical record number already exists.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; registration clerk logged in.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Seed the system with an existing medical record number 'MRN-D-0002'.
Step: 2. Register a new patient with the same medical record number 'MRN-D-0002'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The existing medical record number is present.
ExpectedResult: 2. The registration is rejected and no new patient record is created.

test_cases.description: Verify the rejection message displays the conflicting medical record number.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; registration clerk logged in.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Attempt to register a patient with the duplicate medical record number 'MRN-D-0002'.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The rejection message displays the conflicting medical record number 'MRN-D-0002'.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's white blood cell count exceeds 12 10^9/L AND the patient's temperature exceeds 38 degrees Celsius within the same 24-hour window.

test_cases.description: Verify a sepsis alert triggers when both white blood cell count and temperature exceed thresholds within 24 hours.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record white blood cell count of 16 10^9/L at 09:00.
Step: 2. Record temperature of 40 degrees Celsius within the same 24-hour window.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The white blood cell count is recorded.
ExpectedResult: 2. A sepsis alert is triggered and displayed for the patient.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when neither value exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record white blood cell count of 7 10^9/L.
Step: 2. Record temperature of 36 degrees Celsius.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Both values are recorded below threshold.
ExpectedResult: 2. No sepsis alert is triggered.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when only one factor exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record only white blood cell count above 12 10^9/L (with temperature normal).
Step: 2. Separately record only temperature above 38 degrees Celsius (with white blood cell count normal).
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only white blood cell count elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only temperature elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.

requirement.text: The system SHALL allow a provider to place a pathology order, SHALL allow selection of a collection priority of STAT or Routine, and SHALL print a specimen label containing the patient's MRN and the pathology order ID.

test_cases.description: Verify a provider can place a pathology order with STAT priority.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient chart open.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> pathology.
Step: 2. Select a test and the collection priority 'STAT'.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The pathology ordering screen is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The order is created with priority STAT and appears in the patient's active orders.
ExpectedResult: 3. The collection sticker wording matches the requirement exactly.

test_cases.description: Verify the order cannot be signed without a collection priority.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient chart open.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> pathology and select a test.
Step: 2. Leave the collection priority unselected.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A test is selectable.
ExpectedResult: 2. The order is rejected with a message requiring a priority of STAT or Routine, and no order is created.

test_cases.description: Verify Routine priority and the collection sticker content.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient chart open.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Place the order with the collection priority 'Routine' and sign.
Step: 2. Inspect the printed collection sticker.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The order is created with priority Routine.
ExpectedResult: 2. The collection sticker contains the patient's MRN and the pathology order ID.

requirement.text:
The system SHALL display a 'Latex Allergy' banner on the patient header when the patient has an active latex-allergy order.

test_cases.description: Verify the 'Latex Allergy' banner appears for a patient with an active latex-allergy order.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient with an active latex-allergy order.
Step: 2. Inspect the patient header.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The patient chart opens.
ExpectedResult: 2. The 'Latex Allergy' banner is displayed on the patient header.

test_cases.description: Verify the 'Latex Allergy' banner is absent when no active latex-allergy order exists.

test_cases.steps:

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The patient chart opens.

requirement.text: The system SHALL require two-factor authentication for any user signing in from an IP address outside the on-premises 172.16.0.0/12 range, and SHALL grant access only after a valid second factor is supplied.

test_cases.description: Verify an invalid second factor denies access.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in two-factor authentication; workstation IP outside the on-premises 172.16.0.0/12 range.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. From an IP outside the on-premises 172.16.0.0/12 range, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter an INVALID second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A two-factor authentication challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The invalid second factor is rejected and access is denied.

test_cases.description: Verify the the on-premises 172.16.0.0/12 range boundary is enforced at the edge of the range.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in two-factor authentication; workstation IP outside the on-premises 172.16.0.0/12 range.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Sign in from the last address inside the on-premises 172.16.0.0/12 range.
Step: 2. Sign in from the first address outside the on-premises 172.16.0.0/12 range.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Inside the on-premises 172.16.0.0/12 range no two-factor authentication is required.
ExpectedResult: 2. Just outside the on-premises 172.16.0.0/12 range a two-factor authentication challenge is enforced.

requirement.text: The system SHALL archive vital-sign readings older than 45 days to cold storage and SHALL keep archived readings retrievable within 2 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify readings older than 45 days are archived to cold storage and remain retrievable.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Locate a vital-sign reading dated 75 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier and open it.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is reported as held in cold storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. Its values are retrieved and displayed within 2 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify readings newer than 45 days are not archived to cold storage.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Locate a vital-sign reading dated 1 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is listed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The reading is in active storage and has not been archived to cold storage.

test_cases.description: Verify the 45-day archival boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Inspect a reading dated exactly 45 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect a reading dated exactly 46 days ago.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 45 days the reading is still in active storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 46 days the reading has been archived to cold storage.

requirement.text: The system SHALL let a nurse document a medication administration of Furosemide 40 mg, SHALL capture the administration time, and SHALL block a duplicate medication administration within 15 minutes of the previous one for the same medication.

test_cases.description: Verify a nurse can document a medication administration of Furosemide 40 mg.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Furosemide 40 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open the Medication Administration Record.
Step: 2. Select the active Furosemide 40 mg order and document the administration.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Medication Administration Record is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The medication administration is documented and Furosemide 40 mg is shown as administered.

test_cases.description: Verify a duplicate medication administration within 15 minutes is blocked.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Furosemide 40 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Given Furosemide 40 mg was administered 5 minutes ago, select the same order.
Step: 2. Attempt a second administration and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Furosemide 40 mg order is selectable.
ExpectedResult: 2. The second administration is blocked citing the duplicate within 15 minutes, and no second record is written.

test_cases.description: Verify the 15-minute duplicate boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Furosemide 40 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Attempt a second medication administration at exactly 15 minutes after the first.
Step: 2. Attempt a second medication administration at 15 minutes minus 1 second after the first.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 15 minutes the administration is accepted.
ExpectedResult: 2. Just under 15 minutes the administration is blocked.

requirement.text: The system SHALL deliver a critical lab value notification for INR to the ordering provider's secure inbox within 5 minutes of result verification.

test_cases.description: Verify a critical lab value notification for INR is delivered within 5 minutes of verification.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding INR order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Verify a critical INR result and record the verification time.
Step: 2. Open the secure inbox and record the notification arrival time.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The critical INR result is verified.
ExpectedResult: 2. A critical lab value notification is present in the secure inbox and the interval is at or under 5 minutes.

test_cases.description: Verify duplicate verification events do not create a second notification.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding INR order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Emit the same verified INR result twice.
Step: 2. Inspect the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The result is verified twice.
ExpectedResult: 2. Exactly one critical lab value notification is present in the secure inbox; the duplicate is suppressed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 5-minute delivery boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding INR order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical INR result and measure delivery latency to the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is recorded as delivered within 5 minutes of verification.

requirement.text: The system SHALL transmit a signed prescription to the selected pharmacy within 90 seconds of signing and SHALL update the order status to 'Sent' upon receiving pharmacy confirmation.

test_cases.description: Verify a signed prescription is transmitted to the selected pharmacy.

Step: 2. Click 'Sign & Send' and observe transmission.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The pharmacy is selected.
ExpectedResult: 2. The signed prescription is transmitted to the selected pharmacy.

test_cases.description: Verify status does not become 'Sent' when the pharmacy is unreachable.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test pharmacy 'Riverside #2' configured to confirm receipt.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Disable the pharmacy endpoint.
Step: 2. Sign and send a prescription and observe status.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The endpoint is unreachable.

test_cases.description: Verify the order status updates to 'Sent' upon pharmacy confirmation.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test pharmacy 'Riverside #2' configured to confirm receipt.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Transmit a prescription and have the pharmacy return confirmation.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. On pharmacy confirmation the order status updates to 'Sent'.

requirement.text:
The system SHALL display the estimated GFR computed from creatinine, age and sex on the patient header, rounded to 0 decimal place(s).

test_cases.description: Verify estimated GFR is computed from creatinine, age and sex and displayed.

test_cases.description: Verify the displayed estimated GFR is rounded to 0 decimal place(s).

test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Set creatinine, age and sex to values whose estimated GFR is non-terminating and inspect the header.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The displayed estimated GFR shows no more than 0 decimal place(s).

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a medication order when the ordered daily dose of Sertraline exceeds the formulary maximum daily dose of 200 mg defined in the formulary, and SHALL display the formulary maximum daily dose in the rejection message.

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 4 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

test_cases.description: Verify the account locks after 4 consecutive failed logins within 10 minutes.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 4 consecutive failed login attempts for 'user.t410' within 10 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt a further login using the CORRECT password.

ExpectedResult: 1. After the 4th consecutive failure the account is locked.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied despite correct credentials and a lockout notice naming the account and lockout duration is shown.

test_cases.description: Verify the 4-attempt / 10-minute boundary.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 3 failures the account remains unlocked.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 4 failures within 10 minutes the account locks and the lockout notice appears.
ExpectedResult: 3. The final failure falls outside the 10-minute window, so the account remains unlocked.

requirement.text: The system SHALL automatically end a clinical session after 25 minutes without user input and SHALL require re-authentication before the chart can be accessed again.

test_cases.description: Verify input before the timeout keeps the session active.

test_cases.steps:

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The session remains active and no prompt appears.
ExpectedResult: 2. The session remains active because each input resets the inactivity timer.

test_cases.description: Verify the 25-minute inactivity boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx25' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 25 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for exactly 25 minutes minus 1 second; inspect state.

test_cases.expectedResults:

ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 25 minutes the session ends and re-authentication is required.

requirement.text: The system SHALL alert the ordering provider when two active medications (Digoxin and Amiodarone) have a known major drug-drug interaction, and the alert SHALL name both interacting medications.

test_cases.description: Verify a major drug-drug interaction alert is raised naming both medications.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Digoxin + Amiodarone as a major interaction.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm Digoxin is active for the test patient.

requirement.text: The system SHALL restrict access to psychotherapy notes to users holding the Psychiatry role and SHALL deny access to all other roles, recording each denied attempt in the audit log.

test_cases.expectedResults:

test_cases.description: Verify a user without the Psychiatry role is denied access.

Step: 2. Attempt to open the psychotherapy notes.
test_cases.expectedResults:

requirement.text: The system SHALL calculate a Ibuprofen dose as 10 milligrams per kilogram of the patient's recorded body weight and SHALL round the calculated dose to 1 decimal place(s).

test_cases.description: Verify the Ibuprofen dose is calculated as 10 mg/kg of recorded body weight.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Ibuprofen dosing is 10 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm the recorded body weight is 12.0 kg.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Ibuprofen dosing at 10 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded body weight of 12.0 kg is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The system calculates and displays a dose of 120.0 mg.

test_cases.description: Verify calculation is blocked when no recorded body weight is recorded.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Ibuprofen dosing is 10 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient with NO recorded body weight.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Ibuprofen dosing at 10 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The chart shows no recorded body weight.
ExpectedResult: 2. No dose is calculated; an error states a recorded weight is required and the order cannot be signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the calculated dose is rounded to 1 decimal place(s).
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Ibuprofen dosing is 10 mg/kg.

Step: 2. Set the recorded body weight to 12.344 kg and repeat.
test_cases.expectedResults:

ExpectedResult: 2. The displayed dose shows no more than 1 decimal place(s).

requirement.text: The system SHALL require a documented override reason of at least 10 characters when a provider dismisses a high-severity allergy alert, and SHALL store the override reason with the order.

test_cases.description: Verify a high-severity allergy alert can be dismissed with a sufficient override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a high-severity allergy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the high-severity allergy alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of at least 10 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The high-severity allergy alert is presented and a override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is accepted and the order is signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the alert cannot be dismissed with no override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a high-severity allergy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the high-severity allergy alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Leave the override reason empty and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is rejected, a message requires a override reason, and the order is not signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 10-character minimum override reason boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a high-severity allergy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Enter a override reason of 9 characters and confirm.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of exactly 10 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 9 characters the override is rejected, below the 10-character minimum.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 10 characters the override is accepted.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a new patient registration when the supplied medical record number (MRN-E) already exists in the system, and SHALL display the conflicting medical record number in the rejection message.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The registration form is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The patient is registered and the chart is created with medical record number 'MRN-E-0001'.

test_cases.description: Verify registration is rejected when the medical record number already exists.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; registration clerk logged in.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Seed the system with an existing medical record number 'MRN-E-0002'.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The existing medical record number is present.
ExpectedResult: 2. The registration is rejected and no new patient record is created.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's lactate exceeds 2 mmol/L AND the patient's heart rate exceeds 100 bpm within the same 6-hour window.

test_cases.description: Verify a sepsis alert triggers when both lactate and heart rate exceed thresholds within 6 hours.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record lactate of 4 mmol/L at 09:00.
Step: 2. Record heart rate of 102 bpm within the same 6-hour window.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The lactate is recorded.
ExpectedResult: 2. A sepsis alert is triggered and displayed for the patient.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when neither value exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record lactate of -3 mmol/L.
Step: 2. Record heart rate of 98 bpm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Both values are recorded below threshold.
ExpectedResult: 2. No sepsis alert is triggered.

test_cases.description: Verify the exact thresholds and the 6-hour window boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record lactate of exactly 2 mmol/L and heart rate of exactly 100 bpm.
Step: 2. Record both values above threshold but 6 hours and 1 minute apart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 2 mmol/L / 100 bpm no sepsis alert triggers (values must strictly exceed).
ExpectedResult: 2. Outside the 6-hour window no sepsis alert triggers.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when only one factor exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record only lactate above 2 mmol/L (with heart rate normal).
Step: 2. Separately record only heart rate above 100 bpm (with lactate normal).
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only lactate elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only heart rate elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.

requirement.text: The system SHALL allow a provider to place a blood-bank order, SHALL allow selection of a collection priority of STAT or Routine, and SHALL print a specimen label containing the patient's MRN and the blood-bank order ID.

test_cases.description: Verify a provider can place a blood-bank order with STAT priority.

test_cases.expectedResults:

test_cases.description: Verify the order cannot be signed without a collection priority.

Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> blood-bank and select a test.
Step: 2. Leave the collection priority unselected.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A test is selectable.
ExpectedResult: 2. The order is rejected with a message requiring a priority of STAT or Routine, and no order is created.

requirement.text:
The system SHALL display a 'Elopement Risk' banner on the patient header when the patient has an active elopement-risk order.

requirement.text: The system SHALL require two-factor authentication for any user signing in from an IP address outside the corporate 192.168.0.0/16 range, and SHALL grant access only after a valid second factor is supplied.

test_cases.description: Verify two-factor authentication is required and grants access from an external IP.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. From an IP outside the corporate 192.168.0.0/16 range, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter a valid second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The source IP is recognised as outside the corporate 192.168.0.0/16 range and a two-factor authentication challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The valid second factor is accepted and access is granted.

test_cases.description: Verify an invalid second factor denies access.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in two-factor authentication; workstation IP outside the corporate 192.168.0.0/16 range.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. From an IP outside the corporate 192.168.0.0/16 range, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter an INVALID second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A two-factor authentication challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The invalid second factor is rejected and access is denied.

test_cases.description: Verify the the corporate 192.168.0.0/16 range boundary is enforced at the edge of the range.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in two-factor authentication; workstation IP outside the corporate 192.168.0.0/16 range.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Sign in from the last address inside the corporate 192.168.0.0/16 range.
Step: 2. Sign in from the first address outside the corporate 192.168.0.0/16 range.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Inside the corporate 192.168.0.0/16 range no two-factor authentication is required.
ExpectedResult: 2. Just outside the corporate 192.168.0.0/16 range a two-factor authentication challenge is enforced.

requirement.text: The system SHALL archive vital-sign readings older than 45 days to cold storage and SHALL keep archived readings retrievable within 5 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify readings older than 45 days are archived to cold storage and remain retrievable.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Locate a vital-sign reading dated 75 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier and open it.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is reported as held in cold storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. Its values are retrieved and displayed within 5 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify readings newer than 45 days are not archived to cold storage.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Locate a vital-sign reading dated 1 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is listed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The reading is in active storage and has not been archived to cold storage.

test_cases.description: Verify the 45-day archival boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Inspect a reading dated exactly 45 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect a reading dated exactly 46 days ago.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 45 days the reading is still in active storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 46 days the reading has been archived to cold storage.

requirement.text: The system SHALL let a nurse document a medication administration of Acetaminophen 650 mg, SHALL capture the administration time, and SHALL block a duplicate medication administration within 15 minutes of the previous one for the same medication.

test_cases.description: Verify a nurse can document a medication administration of Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open the Medication Administration Record.
Step: 2. Select the active Acetaminophen 650 mg order and document the administration.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Medication Administration Record is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The medication administration is documented and Acetaminophen 650 mg is shown as administered.

test_cases.description: Verify a duplicate medication administration within 15 minutes is blocked.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Given Acetaminophen 650 mg was administered 5 minutes ago, select the same order.
Step: 2. Attempt a second administration and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Acetaminophen 650 mg order is selectable.
ExpectedResult: 2. The second administration is blocked citing the duplicate within 15 minutes, and no second record is written.

test_cases.description: Verify the 15-minute duplicate boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Attempt a second medication administration at exactly 15 minutes after the first.
Step: 2. Attempt a second medication administration at 15 minutes minus 1 second after the first.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 15 minutes the administration is accepted.
ExpectedResult: 2. Just under 15 minutes the administration is blocked.

test_cases.description: Verify the administration time is captured and persisted.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Document a medication administration and open the recorded entry.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded entry stores the administration time.

requirement.text: The system SHALL deliver a critical lab value notification for glucose to the ordering provider's secure inbox within 5 minutes of result verification.

test_cases.description: Verify a critical lab value notification for glucose is delivered within 5 minutes of verification.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding glucose order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Verify a critical glucose result and record the verification time.
Step: 2. Open the secure inbox and record the notification arrival time.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The critical glucose result is verified.
ExpectedResult: 2. A critical lab value notification is present in the secure inbox and the interval is at or under 5 minutes.

test_cases.description: Verify duplicate verification events do not create a second notification.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding glucose order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Emit the same verified glucose result twice.
Step: 2. Inspect the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The result is verified twice.
ExpectedResult: 2. Exactly one critical lab value notification is present in the secure inbox; the duplicate is suppressed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 5-minute delivery boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding glucose order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical glucose result and measure delivery latency to the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is recorded as delivered within 5 minutes of verification.

test_cases.description: Verify the notification routes to the ordering provider specifically.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding glucose order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical glucose result ordered by 'dr.t' and inspect the recipient.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is routed to the ordering provider's secure inbox, not to any other recipient.

requirement.text: The system SHALL transmit a signed prescription to the selected pharmacy within 120 seconds of signing and SHALL update the order status to 'Sent' upon receiving pharmacy confirmation.

test_cases.description: Verify status does not become 'Sent' when the pharmacy is unreachable.

test_cases.expectedResults:

test_cases.description: Verify transmission occurs within the 120-second limit.

Step: 1. Sign a signed prescription and record the signing time.

test_cases.description: Verify the order status updates to 'Sent' upon pharmacy confirmation.

test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Transmit a prescription and have the pharmacy return confirmation.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. On pharmacy confirmation the order status updates to 'Sent'.

requirement.text:

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a medication order when the ordered daily dose of Amlodipine exceeds the formulary maximum daily dose of 10 mg defined in the formulary, and SHALL display the formulary maximum daily dose in the rejection message.

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 4 consecutive failed login attempts within a 15-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

test_cases.description: Verify the account locks after 4 consecutive failed logins within 15 minutes.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t415' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 4 consecutive failed login attempts for 'user.t415' within 15 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt a further login using the CORRECT password.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the 4th consecutive failure the account is locked.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied despite correct credentials and a suspension banner naming the account and lockout duration is shown.

test_cases.description: Verify a successful login before the threshold resets the counter.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t415' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 3 failed attempts, then log in with the correct password.
Step: 2. Log out and submit 3 further failed attempts.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the correct login the failed-attempt counter resets to 0.
ExpectedResult: 2. The account remains unlocked and no suspension banner appears, because no window contains 4 consecutive failures.

test_cases.description: Verify the 4-attempt / 15-minute boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t415' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit exactly 3 failed attempts within 15 minutes and inspect state.
Step: 2. Submit an 4th failed attempt at minute 14 and inspect state.
Step: 3. For a fresh account submit 3 failures, wait past minute 15, then submit one more.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 3 failures the account remains unlocked.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 4 failures within 15 minutes the account locks and the suspension banner appears.
ExpectedResult: 3. The final failure falls outside the 15-minute window, so the account remains unlocked.

requirement.text: The system SHALL automatically end a clinical session after 30 minutes without user input and SHALL require re-authentication before the chart can be accessed again.

test_cases.description: Verify a session ends after 30 minutes of no input and requires re-authentication.

ExpectedResult: 2. The chart is inaccessible and a re-authentication prompt is displayed; access is restored only after valid credentials.

test_cases.description: Verify input before the timeout keeps the session active.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for 29 minutes, then click within the chart.
Step: 2. Remain idle for a further 29 minutes, then click within the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The session remains active and no prompt appears.
ExpectedResult: 2. The session remains active because each input resets the inactivity timer.

test_cases.description: Verify the 30-minute inactivity boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx30' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 30 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for exactly 30 minutes minus 1 second; inspect state.
Step: 2. Allow inactivity to reach exactly 30 minutes 0 seconds; inspect state.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Just under 30 minutes the session is still active.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 30 minutes the session ends and re-authentication is required.

test_cases.steps:

Step: 2. Order and sign Trimethoprim for the patient.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Methotrexate is shown as active.

test_cases.description: Verify no alert is raised for a non-interacting pair.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's heart rate exceeds 100 bpm AND the patient's respiratory rate exceeds 20 breaths/min within the same 1-hour window.

Step: 2. Record respiratory rate of 22 breaths/min within the same 1-hour window.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The heart rate is recorded.
ExpectedResult: 2. A sepsis alert is triggered and displayed for the patient.

test_cases.description: Verify the exact thresholds and the 1-hour window boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record heart rate of exactly 100 bpm and respiratory rate of exactly 20 breaths/min.
Step: 2. Record both values above threshold but 1 hours and 1 minute apart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 100 bpm / 20 breaths/min no sepsis alert triggers (values must strictly exceed).
ExpectedResult: 2. Outside the 1-hour window no sepsis alert triggers.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only heart rate elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only respiratory rate elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.

test_cases.description: Verify the alert cannot be dismissed with no override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a critical drug-interaction alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the critical drug-interaction alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Leave the override reason empty and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is rejected, a message requires a override reason, and the order is not signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 10-character minimum override reason boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a critical drug-interaction alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Enter a override reason of 9 characters and confirm.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of exactly 10 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 9 characters the override is rejected, below the 10-character minimum.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 10 characters the override is accepted.

test_cases.description: Verify the accepted override reason is stored with the order.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a critical drug-interaction alert.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Dismiss the critical drug-interaction alert with a valid override reason and open the signed order detail.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The stored order detail shows the exact override reason text that was entered.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a new patient registration when the supplied medical record number (MRN-G) already exists in the system, and SHALL display the conflicting medical record number in the rejection message.

test_cases.description: Verify registration is rejected when the medical record number already exists.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; registration clerk logged in.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Seed the system with an existing medical record number 'MRN-G-0002'.
Step: 2. Register a new patient with the same medical record number 'MRN-G-0002'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The existing medical record number is present.
ExpectedResult: 2. The registration is rejected and no new patient record is created.

test_cases.description: Verify the rejection message displays the conflicting medical record number.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; registration clerk logged in.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Attempt to register a patient with the duplicate medical record number 'MRN-G-0002'.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The rejection message displays the conflicting medical record number 'MRN-G-0002'.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's temperature exceeds 39 degrees Celsius AND the patient's heart rate exceeds 120 bpm within the same 3-hour window.

test_cases.description: Verify a sepsis alert triggers when both temperature and heart rate exceed thresholds within 3 hours.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record temperature of 48 degrees Celsius at 09:00.
Step: 2. Record heart rate of 122 bpm within the same 3-hour window.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The temperature is recorded.
ExpectedResult: 2. A sepsis alert is triggered and displayed for the patient.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when neither value exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record temperature of 34 degrees Celsius.
Step: 2. Record heart rate of 118 bpm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Both values are recorded below threshold.
ExpectedResult: 2. No sepsis alert is triggered.

test_cases.description: Verify the exact thresholds and the 3-hour window boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record temperature of exactly 39 degrees Celsius and heart rate of exactly 120 bpm.
Step: 2. Record both values above threshold but 3 hours and 1 minute apart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 39 degrees Celsius / 120 bpm no sepsis alert triggers (values must strictly exceed).
ExpectedResult: 2. Outside the 3-hour window no sepsis alert triggers.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when only one factor exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record only temperature above 39 degrees Celsius (with heart rate normal).
Step: 2. Separately record only heart rate above 120 bpm (with temperature normal).
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only temperature elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only heart rate elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.

requirement.text: The system SHALL allow a provider to place a cardiology-diagnostic order, SHALL allow selection of a collection priority of STAT or Routine, and SHALL print a specimen label containing the patient's MRN and the cardiology-diagnostic order ID.

test_cases.description: Verify a provider can place a cardiology-diagnostic order with STAT priority.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient chart open.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> cardiology-diagnostic.
Step: 2. Select a test and the collection priority 'STAT'.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The cardiology-diagnostic ordering screen is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The order is created with priority STAT and appears in the patient's active orders.
ExpectedResult: 3. The specimen label wording matches the requirement exactly.

test_cases.description: Verify the order cannot be signed without a collection priority.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient chart open.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> cardiology-diagnostic and select a test.
Step: 2. Leave the collection priority unselected.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A test is selectable.
ExpectedResult: 2. The order is rejected with a message requiring a priority of STAT or Routine, and no order is created.

test_cases.description: Verify Routine priority and the specimen label content.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient chart open.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Place the order with the collection priority 'Routine' and sign.
Step: 2. Inspect the printed specimen label.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The order is created with priority Routine.
ExpectedResult: 2. The specimen label contains the patient's MRN and the cardiology-diagnostic order ID.

requirement.text:
The system SHALL display a 'Seizure Precautions' banner on the patient header when the patient has an active seizure-precaution order.

Context: this requirement applies to active seizure-precaution orders only; non-active seizure-precaution orders are covered elsewhere.

test_cases.description: Verify the 'Seizure Precautions' banner appears for a patient with an active seizure-precaution order.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient with an active seizure-precaution order.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The patient chart opens.
ExpectedResult: 2. The 'Seizure Precautions' banner is displayed on the patient header.

test_cases.description: Verify the 'Seizure Precautions' banner is absent when no active seizure-precaution order exists.

test_cases.expectedResults:
