requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a medication order when the ordered daily dose of Morphine exceeds the formulary maximum daily dose of 120 mg defined in the formulary, and SHALL display the formulary maximum daily dose in the rejection message.

test_cases.description: Verify a Morphine order within the formulary maximum daily dose is accepted.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary formulary maximum daily dose for Morphine is 120 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> Medications and select Morphine.
Step: 2. Enter a regimen totalling 60 mg per day.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The medication ordering screen is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The daily total of 60 mg is calculated and shown.
ExpectedResult: 3. The order is accepted and saved, within the formulary maximum daily dose of 120 mg.

test_cases.description: Verify the formulary maximum daily dose boundary for Morphine.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary formulary maximum daily dose for Morphine is 120 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Order Morphine totalling exactly 120 mg per day and sign.
Step: 2. Order Morphine totalling 121 mg per day and sign.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 120 mg the order is accepted, because the dose did not EXCEED the maximum.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 121 mg the order is rejected.

test_cases.description: Verify the rejection message displays the formulary maximum daily dose value.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary formulary maximum daily dose for Morphine is 120 mg.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Order Morphine totalling 180 mg per day and attempt to sign.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The rejection message states the formulary maximum daily dose of 120 mg.

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 20-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

test_cases.description: Verify the account locks after 5 consecutive failed logins within 20 minutes.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t520' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 5 consecutive failed login attempts for 'user.t520' within 20 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt a further login using the CORRECT password.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the 5th consecutive failure the account is locked.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied despite correct credentials and a suspension banner naming the account and lockout duration is shown.

test_cases.description: Verify a successful login before the threshold resets the counter.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t520' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 4 failed attempts, then log in with the correct password.
Step: 2. Log out and submit 4 further failed attempts.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the correct login the failed-attempt counter resets to 0.
ExpectedResult: 2. The account remains unlocked and no suspension banner appears, because no window contains 5 consecutive failures.

test_cases.description: Verify the 5-attempt / 20-minute boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t520' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit exactly 4 failed attempts within 20 minutes and inspect state.
Step: 2. Submit an 5th failed attempt at minute 19 and inspect state.
Step: 3. For a fresh account submit 4 failures, wait past minute 20, then submit one more.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 4 failures the account remains unlocked.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 5 failures within 20 minutes the account locks and the suspension banner appears.
ExpectedResult: 3. The final failure falls outside the 20-minute window, so the account remains unlocked.

requirement.text: The system SHALL automatically end a clinical session after 18 minutes without user input and SHALL require re-authentication before the chart can be accessed again.

test_cases.description: Verify a session ends after 18 minutes of no input and requires re-authentication.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx18' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 18 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient chart and leave the workstation idle for 18 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt to scroll the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 18 minutes of inactivity the session ends and the chart is hidden.
ExpectedResult: 2. The chart is inaccessible and a re-authentication prompt is displayed; access is restored only after valid credentials.

test_cases.description: Verify input before the timeout keeps the session active.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx18' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 18 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for 17 minutes, then click within the chart.
Step: 2. Remain idle for a further 17 minutes, then click within the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The session remains active and no prompt appears.
ExpectedResult: 2. The session remains active because each input resets the inactivity timer.

test_cases.description: Verify the 18-minute inactivity boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx18' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 18 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for exactly 18 minutes minus 1 second; inspect state.
Step: 2. Allow inactivity to reach exactly 18 minutes 0 seconds; inspect state.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Just under 18 minutes the session is still active.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 18 minutes the session ends and re-authentication is required.

requirement.text: The system SHALL alert the ordering provider when two active medications (Spironolactone and Potassium chloride) have a known major drug-drug interaction, and the alert SHALL name both interacting medications.

test_cases.description: Verify a major pharmacy conflict flag is raised naming both medications.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Spironolactone + Potassium chloride as a major interaction.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm Spironolactone is active for the test patient.
Step: 2. Order and sign Potassium chloride for the patient.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Spironolactone is shown as active.
ExpectedResult: 2. A major pharmacy conflict flag is presented and the alert text names both Spironolactone and Potassium chloride.

test_cases.description: Verify no alert is raised for a non-interacting pair.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Spironolactone + Potassium chloride as a major interaction.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm the patient has an active medication with no known interaction with the ordered drug.
Step: 2. Order and sign a non-interacting medication.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The prior medication is active.
ExpectedResult: 2. The order is signed with no pharmacy conflict flag presented.

test_cases.description: Verify the pharmacy conflict flag text names both interacting medications.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Spironolactone + Potassium chloride as a major interaction.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Trigger the Spironolactone + Potassium chloride interaction and inspect the alert text.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The alert text explicitly contains both 'Spironolactone' and 'Potassium chloride' by name.

requirement.text: The system SHALL restrict access to sexual-assault examination records to users holding the Forensic Nursing role and SHALL deny access to all other roles, recording each denied attempt in the audit log.

test_cases.description: Verify a Forensic Nursing role holder can open a sexual-assault examination records record.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'auth.t' holds the Forensic Nursing role; a sexual-assault examination records record exists for the test patient.
test_cases.steps:

Step: 2. Open the patient's sexual-assault examination records.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Forensic Nursing role is active.
ExpectedResult: 2. The sexual-assault examination records opens and its content is displayed.

test_cases.description: Verify a user without the Forensic Nursing role is denied access.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'auth.t' holds the Forensic Nursing role; a sexual-assault examination records record exists for the test patient.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Log in as a user WITHOUT the Forensic Nursing role.
Step: 2. Attempt to open the sexual-assault examination records.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Login succeeds without the Forensic Nursing role.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied and no sexual-assault examination records content is displayed.

test_cases.description: Verify each denied attempt is recorded in the audit log.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'auth.t' holds the Forensic Nursing role; a sexual-assault examination records record exists for the test patient.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. As a non-Forensic Nursing role user attempt to open the sexual-assault examination records.
Step: 2. As an auditor query the audit log for denials.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Access is denied.
ExpectedResult: 2. An audit entry recording the denied attempt is present.

requirement.text: The system SHALL calculate a Ampicillin dose as 25 milligrams per kilogram of the patient's recorded body weight and SHALL round the calculated dose to 1 decimal place(s).

test_cases.description: Verify the Ampicillin dose is calculated as 25 mg/kg of recorded body weight.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Ampicillin dosing is 25 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm the recorded body weight is 12.0 kg.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Ampicillin dosing at 25 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded body weight of 12.0 kg is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The system calculates and displays a dose of 300.0 mg.

test_cases.description: Verify calculation is blocked when no recorded body weight is recorded.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Ampicillin dosing is 25 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient with NO recorded body weight.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Ampicillin dosing at 25 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The chart shows no recorded body weight.
ExpectedResult: 2. No dose is calculated; an error states a recorded weight is required and the order cannot be signed.

requirement.text: The system SHALL require a documented override reason of at least 12 characters when a provider dismisses a critical drug-interaction alert, and SHALL store the override reason with the order.

test_cases.description: Verify a critical drug-interaction alert can be dismissed with a sufficient override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a critical drug-interaction alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the critical drug-interaction alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of at least 12 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The critical drug-interaction alert is presented and a override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is accepted and the order is signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the alert cannot be dismissed with no override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a critical drug-interaction alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the critical drug-interaction alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Leave the override reason empty and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is rejected, a message requires a override reason, and the order is not signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 12-character minimum override reason boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a critical drug-interaction alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Enter a override reason of 11 characters and confirm.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of exactly 12 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 11 characters the override is rejected, below the 12-character minimum.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 12 characters the override is accepted.

test_cases.description: Verify the accepted override reason is stored with the order.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a critical drug-interaction alert.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Dismiss the critical drug-interaction alert with a valid override reason and open the signed order detail.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The stored order detail shows the exact override reason text that was entered.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a new patient registration when the supplied medical record number (MRN-L) already exists in the system, and SHALL display the conflicting medical record number in the rejection message.

test_cases.description: Verify registration is rejected when the patient index key already exists.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's bilirubin exceeds 3 mg/dL AND the patient's temperature exceeds 38 degrees Celsius within the same 8-hour window.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when neither value exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record bilirubin of -2 mg/dL.
Step: 2. Record temperature of 36 degrees Celsius.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Both values are recorded below threshold.
ExpectedResult: 2. No sepsis alert is triggered.

test_cases.description: Verify the exact thresholds and the 8-hour window boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record bilirubin of exactly 3 mg/dL and temperature of exactly 38 degrees Celsius.
Step: 2. Record both values above threshold but 8 hours and 1 minute apart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 3 mg/dL / 38 degrees Celsius no sepsis alert triggers (values must strictly exceed).
ExpectedResult: 2. Outside the 8-hour window no sepsis alert triggers.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when only one factor exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record only bilirubin above 3 mg/dL (with temperature normal).
Step: 2. Separately record only temperature above 38 degrees Celsius (with bilirubin normal).
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only bilirubin elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only temperature elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.

requirement.text: The system SHALL allow a provider to place a toxicology order, SHALL allow selection of a collection priority of STAT or Routine, and SHALL print a specimen label containing the patient's MRN and the toxicology order ID.

requirement.text: The system SHALL require two-factor authentication for any user signing in from an IP address outside the pharmacy network segment, and SHALL grant access only after a valid second factor is supplied.

test_cases.description: Verify two-factor authentication is required and grants access from an external IP.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in two-factor authentication; workstation IP outside the pharmacy network segment.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. From an IP outside the pharmacy network segment, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter a valid second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The source IP is recognised as outside the pharmacy network segment and a two-factor authentication challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The valid second factor is accepted and access is granted.

test_cases.description: Verify an invalid second factor denies access.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in two-factor authentication; workstation IP outside the pharmacy network segment.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. From an IP outside the pharmacy network segment, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter an INVALID second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A two-factor authentication challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The invalid second factor is rejected and access is denied.

test_cases.description: Verify the the pharmacy network segment boundary is enforced at the edge of the range.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in two-factor authentication; workstation IP outside the pharmacy network segment.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Sign in from the last address inside the pharmacy network segment.
Step: 2. Sign in from the first address outside the pharmacy network segment.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Inside the pharmacy network segment no two-factor authentication is required.
ExpectedResult: 2. Just outside the pharmacy network segment a two-factor authentication challenge is enforced.

requirement.text: The system SHALL archive vital-sign readings older than 90 days to cold storage and SHALL keep archived readings retrievable within 5 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify readings older than 90 days are archived to a deep archive vault and remain retrievable.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Locate a vital-sign reading dated 120 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier and open it.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is reported as held in a deep archive vault.
ExpectedResult: 2. Its values are retrieved and displayed within 5 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify readings newer than 90 days are not archived to a deep archive vault.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Locate a vital-sign reading dated 30 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is listed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The reading is in active storage and has not been archived to a deep archive vault.

test_cases.description: Verify the 90-day archival boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Inspect a reading dated exactly 90 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect a reading dated exactly 91 days ago.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 90 days the reading is still in active storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 91 days the reading has been archived to a deep archive vault.

requirement.text: The system SHALL let a nurse document a medication administration of Acetaminophen 650 mg, SHALL capture the administration time, and SHALL block a duplicate medication administration within 30 minutes of the previous one for the same medication.

test_cases.description: Verify a nurse can document a medication administration of Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open the Medication Administration Record.
Step: 2. Select the active Acetaminophen 650 mg order and document the administration.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Medication Administration Record is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The medication administration is documented and Acetaminophen 650 mg is shown as administered.

test_cases.description: Verify a duplicate medication administration within 30 minutes is blocked.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Given Acetaminophen 650 mg was administered 5 minutes ago, select the same order.
Step: 2. Attempt a second administration and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Acetaminophen 650 mg order is selectable.
ExpectedResult: 2. The second administration is blocked citing the duplicate within 30 minutes, and no second record is written.

test_cases.description: Verify the 30-minute duplicate boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Attempt a second medication administration at exactly 30 minutes after the first.
Step: 2. Attempt a second medication administration at 30 minutes minus 1 second after the first.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 30 minutes the administration is accepted.
ExpectedResult: 2. Just under 30 minutes the administration is blocked.

test_cases.description: Verify the administration time is captured and persisted.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Document a medication administration and open the recorded entry.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded entry stores the administration time.

requirement.text: The system SHALL deliver a critical lab value notification for hemoglobin to the ordering provider's secure inbox within 10 minutes of result verification.

test_cases.description: Verify duplicate verification events do not create a second notification.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding hemoglobin order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Emit the same verified hemoglobin result twice.
Step: 2. Inspect the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The result is verified twice.
ExpectedResult: 2. Exactly one critical lab value notification is present in the secure inbox; the duplicate is suppressed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 10-minute delivery boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding hemoglobin order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical hemoglobin result and measure delivery latency to the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is recorded as delivered within 10 minutes of verification.

test_cases.description: Verify the notification routes to the ordering provider specifically.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding hemoglobin order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical hemoglobin result ordered by 'dr.t' and inspect the recipient.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is routed to the ordering provider's secure inbox, not to any other recipient.

requirement.text: The system SHALL transmit a signed prescription to the selected pharmacy within 75 seconds of signing and SHALL update the order status to 'Sent' upon receiving pharmacy confirmation.

test_cases.description: Verify a signed prescription is transmitted to the selected pharmacy.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test pharmacy 'Riverside #2' configured to confirm receipt.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Select a medication and destination pharmacy.
Step: 2. Click 'Sign & Send' and observe transmission.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The pharmacy is selected.
ExpectedResult: 2. The signed prescription is transmitted to the selected pharmacy.

test_cases.description: Verify status does not become 'Sent' when the pharmacy is unreachable.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test pharmacy 'Riverside #2' configured to confirm receipt.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Disable the pharmacy endpoint.
Step: 2. Sign and send a prescription and observe status.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The endpoint is unreachable.
ExpectedResult: 2. Transmission fails, an error is shown, and the status does NOT become 'Sent'.

test_cases.description: Verify transmission occurs within the 75-second limit.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test pharmacy 'Riverside #2' configured to confirm receipt.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Sign a signed prescription and record the signing time.
Step: 2. Record the arrival time at the pharmacy interface.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The elapsed interval between signing and arrival is at or under 75 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify the order status updates to 'Sent' upon pharmacy confirmation.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test pharmacy 'Riverside #2' configured to confirm receipt.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Transmit a prescription and have the pharmacy return confirmation.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. On pharmacy confirmation the order status updates to 'Sent'.

requirement.text:
The system SHALL display the shock index computed from heart rate and systolic pressure on the patient header, rounded to 2 decimal place(s).

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a medication order when the ordered daily dose of Oxycodone exceeds the formulary maximum daily dose of 80 mg defined in the formulary, and SHALL display the formulary maximum daily dose in the rejection message.

test_cases.description: Verify a Oxycodone order within the formulary maximum daily dose is accepted.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary formulary maximum daily dose for Oxycodone is 80 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> Medications and select Oxycodone.
Step: 2. Enter a regimen totalling 40 mg per day.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The medication ordering screen is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The daily total of 40 mg is calculated and shown.
ExpectedResult: 3. The order is accepted and saved, within the formulary maximum daily dose of 80 mg.

test_cases.description: Verify a Oxycodone order exceeding the formulary maximum daily dose is rejected.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary formulary maximum daily dose for Oxycodone is 80 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> Medications and select Oxycodone.
Step: 2. Enter a regimen totalling 120 mg per day.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:

test_cases.description: Verify the formulary maximum daily dose boundary for Oxycodone.

test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Order Oxycodone totalling 120 mg per day and attempt to sign.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The rejection message states the formulary maximum daily dose of 80 mg.

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 30-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

test_cases.description: Verify the account locks after 5 consecutive failed logins within 30 minutes.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t530' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 5 consecutive failed login attempts for 'user.t530' within 30 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt a further login using the CORRECT password.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the 5th consecutive failure the account is locked.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied despite correct credentials and a lockout notice naming the account and lockout duration is shown.

test_cases.description: Verify the 5-attempt / 30-minute boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t530' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit exactly 4 failed attempts within 30 minutes and inspect state.
Step: 2. Submit an 5th failed attempt at minute 29 and inspect state.
Step: 3. For a fresh account submit 4 failures, wait past minute 30, then submit one more.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 4 failures the account remains unlocked.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 5 failures within 30 minutes the account locks and the lockout notice appears.
ExpectedResult: 3. The final failure falls outside the 30-minute window, so the account remains unlocked.

requirement.text: The system SHALL automatically end a clinical session after 90 minutes without user input and SHALL require re-authentication before the chart can be accessed again.

test_cases.description: Verify a session ends after 90 minutes of no input and requires re-authentication.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx90' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 90 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient chart and leave the workstation idle for 90 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt to scroll the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 90 minutes of inactivity the session ends and the chart is hidden.
ExpectedResult: 2. The chart is inaccessible and a re-authentication prompt is displayed; access is restored only after valid credentials.

test_cases.description: Verify input before the timeout keeps the session active.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx90' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 90 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for 89 minutes, then click within the chart.
Step: 2. Remain idle for a further 89 minutes, then click within the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The session remains active and no prompt appears.
ExpectedResult: 2. The session remains active because each input resets the inactivity timer.

test_cases.description: Verify the 90-minute inactivity boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx90' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 90 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for exactly 90 minutes minus 1 second; inspect state.
Step: 2. Allow inactivity to reach exactly 90 minutes 0 seconds; inspect state.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Just under 90 minutes the session is still active.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 90 minutes the session ends and re-authentication is required.

requirement.text: The system SHALL alert the ordering provider when two active medications (Warfarin and Amiodarone) have a known major drug-drug interaction, and the alert SHALL name both interacting medications.

test_cases.description: Verify a major drug-drug interaction alert is raised naming both medications.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Warfarin + Amiodarone as a major interaction.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm Warfarin is active for the test patient.
Step: 2. Order and sign Amiodarone for the patient.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Warfarin is shown as active.
ExpectedResult: 2. A major drug-drug interaction alert is presented and the alert text names both Warfarin and Amiodarone.

test_cases.description: Verify no alert is raised for a non-interacting pair.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Warfarin + Amiodarone as a major interaction.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm the patient has an active medication with no known interaction with the ordered drug.
Step: 2. Order and sign a non-interacting medication.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The prior medication is active.
ExpectedResult: 2. The order is signed with no drug-drug interaction alert presented.

requirement.text: The system SHALL restrict access to gender-affirming care notes to users holding the Endocrinology role and SHALL deny access to all other roles, recording each denied attempt in the audit log.

test_cases.description: Verify a user without the Endocrinology role is denied access.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'auth.t' holds the Endocrinology role; a gender-affirming care notes record exists for the test patient.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Log in as a user WITHOUT the Endocrinology role.
Step: 2. Attempt to open the gender-affirming care notes.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Login succeeds without the Endocrinology role.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied and no gender-affirming care notes content is displayed.

test_cases.description: Verify each denied attempt is recorded in the audit log.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'auth.t' holds the Endocrinology role; a gender-affirming care notes record exists for the test patient.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. As a non-Endocrinology role user attempt to open the gender-affirming care notes.
Step: 2. As an auditor query the audit log for denials.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Access is denied.
ExpectedResult: 2. An audit entry recording the denied attempt is present.

requirement.text: The system SHALL calculate a Dexamethasone dose as 0.15 milligrams per kilogram of the patient's recorded body weight and SHALL round the calculated dose to 2 decimal place(s).

test_cases.description: Verify the Dexamethasone dose is calculated as 0.15 mg/kg of recorded body weight.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Dexamethasone dosing is 0.15 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm the recorded body weight is 12.0 kg.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Dexamethasone dosing at 0.15 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded body weight of 12.0 kg is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The system calculates and displays a dose of 1.8 mg.

test_cases.description: Verify calculation is blocked when no recorded body weight is recorded.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Dexamethasone dosing is 0.15 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient with NO recorded body weight.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Dexamethasone dosing at 0.15 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The chart shows no recorded body weight.
ExpectedResult: 2. No dose is calculated; an error states a recorded weight is required and the order cannot be signed.

requirement.text: The system SHALL require a documented override reason of at least 12 characters when a provider dismisses a duplicate-therapy alert, and SHALL store the override reason with the order.

test_cases.description: Verify a duplicate-therapy alert can be dismissed with a sufficient override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a duplicate-therapy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the duplicate-therapy alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of at least 12 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The duplicate-therapy alert is presented and a override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is accepted and the order is signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the alert cannot be dismissed with no override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a duplicate-therapy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the duplicate-therapy alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Leave the override reason empty and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is rejected, a message requires a override reason, and the order is not signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 12-character minimum override reason boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a duplicate-therapy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Enter a override reason of 11 characters and confirm.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of exactly 12 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 11 characters the override is rejected, below the 12-character minimum.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 12 characters the override is accepted.

test_cases.description: Verify the accepted override reason is stored with the order.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a duplicate-therapy alert.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Dismiss the duplicate-therapy alert with a valid override reason and open the signed order detail.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The stored order detail shows the exact override reason text that was entered.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a new patient registration when the supplied medical record number (MRN-M) already exists in the system, and SHALL display the conflicting medical record number in the rejection message.

test_cases.description: Verify a new patient can be registered with a unique medical record number.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; registration clerk logged in.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open Patient Registration -> New Patient.
Step: 2. Enter demographics with a unique medical record number 'MRN-M-0001'.
Step: 3. Click 'Register'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The registration form is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The patient is registered and the chart is created with medical record number 'MRN-M-0001'.

test_cases.description: Verify registration is rejected when the medical record number already exists.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; registration clerk logged in.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Seed the system with an existing medical record number 'MRN-M-0002'.
Step: 2. Register a new patient with the same medical record number 'MRN-M-0002'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The existing medical record number is present.

test_cases.description: Verify the rejection message displays the conflicting medical record number.

test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Attempt to register a patient with the duplicate medical record number 'MRN-M-0002'.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The rejection message displays the conflicting medical record number 'MRN-M-0002'.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's glucose exceeds 250 mg/dL AND the patient's heart rate exceeds 100 bpm within the same 6-hour window.

test_cases.description: Verify a sepsis alert triggers when both glucose and heart rate exceed thresholds within 6 hours.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record glucose of 302 mg/dL at 09:00.
Step: 2. Record heart rate of 102 bpm within the same 6-hour window.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The glucose is recorded.
ExpectedResult: 2. A sepsis alert is triggered and displayed for the patient.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when neither value exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record glucose of 245 mg/dL.
Step: 2. Record heart rate of 98 bpm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Both values are recorded below threshold.
ExpectedResult: 2. No sepsis alert is triggered.

test_cases.description: Verify the exact thresholds and the 6-hour window boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record glucose of exactly 250 mg/dL and heart rate of exactly 100 bpm.
Step: 2. Record both values above threshold but 6 hours and 1 minute apart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 250 mg/dL / 100 bpm no sepsis alert triggers (values must strictly exceed).
ExpectedResult: 2. Outside the 6-hour window no sepsis alert triggers.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when only one factor exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record only glucose above 250 mg/dL (with heart rate normal).
Step: 2. Separately record only heart rate above 100 bpm (with glucose normal).
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only glucose elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only heart rate elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.

requirement.text: The system SHALL allow a provider to place a molecular-diagnostics order, SHALL allow selection of a collection priority of STAT or Routine, and SHALL print a specimen label containing the patient's MRN and the molecular-diagnostics order ID.

test_cases.description: Verify the order cannot be signed without a collection priority.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is reported as held in cold storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. Its values are retrieved and displayed within 10 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify readings newer than 90 days are not archived to cold storage.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Locate a vital-sign reading dated 30 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is listed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 90-day archival boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Inspect a reading dated exactly 90 days ago.

test_cases.expectedResults:

test_cases.description: Verify a duplicate medication handoff within 30 minutes is blocked.

Step: 2. Attempt a second administration and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Heparin 5000 units order is selectable.
ExpectedResult: 2. The second administration is blocked citing the duplicate within 30 minutes, and no second record is written.

test_cases.description: Verify the 30-minute duplicate boundary.

test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical INR result and measure delivery latency to the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is recorded as delivered within 10 minutes of verification.

test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is routed to the ordering provider's secure inbox, not to any other recipient.

requirement.text: The system SHALL transmit a signed prescription to the selected pharmacy within 50 seconds of signing and SHALL update the order status to 'Sent' upon receiving pharmacy confirmation.

requirement.text:

test_cases.description: Verify a Prednisone order exceeding the formulary maximum daily dose is rejected.

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 6 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

test_cases.description: Verify the account locks after 6 consecutive failed logins within 10 minutes.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t610' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 6 consecutive failed login attempts for 'user.t610' within 10 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt a further login using the CORRECT password.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the 6th consecutive failure the account is locked.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied despite correct credentials and a lockout notice naming the account and lockout duration is shown.

test_cases.description: Verify a successful login before the threshold resets the counter.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t610' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 5 failed attempts, then log in with the correct password.
Step: 2. Log out and submit 5 further failed attempts.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the correct login the failed-attempt counter resets to 0.
ExpectedResult: 2. The account remains unlocked and no lockout notice appears, because no window contains 6 consecutive failures.

test_cases.description: Verify the 6-attempt / 10-minute boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t610' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit exactly 5 failed attempts within 10 minutes and inspect state.
Step: 2. Submit an 6th failed attempt at minute 9 and inspect state.
Step: 3. For a fresh account submit 5 failures, wait past minute 10, then submit one more.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 5 failures the account remains unlocked.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 6 failures within 10 minutes the account locks and the lockout notice appears.
ExpectedResult: 3. The final failure falls outside the 10-minute window, so the account remains unlocked.

requirement.text: The system SHALL automatically end a clinical session after 120 minutes without user input and SHALL require re-authentication before the chart can be accessed again.

test_cases.description: Verify a session ends after 120 minutes of no input and requires re-authentication.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx120' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 120 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient chart and leave the workstation idle for 120 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt to scroll the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 120 minutes of inactivity the session ends and the chart is hidden.
ExpectedResult: 2. The chart is inaccessible and a re-authentication prompt is displayed; access is restored only after valid credentials.

test_cases.description: Verify input before the timeout keeps the session active.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx120' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 120 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for 119 minutes, then click within the chart.
Step: 2. Remain idle for a further 119 minutes, then click within the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The session remains active and no prompt appears.
ExpectedResult: 2. The session remains active because each input resets the inactivity timer.

test_cases.description: Verify the 120-minute inactivity boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx120' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 120 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for exactly 120 minutes minus 1 second; inspect state.
Step: 2. Allow inactivity to reach exactly 120 minutes 0 seconds; inspect state.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Just under 120 minutes the session is still active.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 120 minutes the session ends and re-authentication is required.

requirement.text: The system SHALL alert the ordering provider when two active medications (Linezolid and Sertraline) have a known major drug-drug interaction, and the alert SHALL name both interacting medications.

requirement.text: The system SHALL restrict access to research-only study data to users holding the Clinical Research role and SHALL deny access to all other roles, recording each denied attempt in the audit log.

requirement.text: The system SHALL calculate a Morphine dose as 0.1 milligrams per kilogram of the patient's recorded body weight and SHALL round the calculated dose to 2 decimal place(s).

requirement.text: The system SHALL require a documented override reason of at least 15 characters when a provider dismisses a high-severity allergy alert, and SHALL store the override reason with the order.

ExpectedResult: 2. The override is accepted and the order is signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the alert cannot be dismissed with no override reason.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A override reason field is shown.

test_cases.description: Verify the 15-character minimum override reason boundary.

test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Dismiss the high-severity allergy alert with a valid override reason and open the signed order detail.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a new patient registration when the supplied medical record number (MRN-N) already exists in the system, and SHALL display the conflicting medical record number in the rejection message.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's respiratory rate exceeds 24 breaths/min AND the patient's oxygen saturation drop below exceeds 92 percent within the same 1-hour window.

test_cases.description: Verify a sepsis alert triggers when both respiratory rate and oxygen saturation drop below exceed thresholds within 1 hours.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record respiratory rate of 30 breaths/min at 09:00.
Step: 2. Record oxygen saturation drop below of 94 percent within the same 1-hour window.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The respiratory rate is recorded.
ExpectedResult: 2. A sepsis alert is triggered and displayed for the patient.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when neither value exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record respiratory rate of 19 breaths/min.
Step: 2. Record oxygen saturation drop below of 90 percent.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Both values are recorded below threshold.
ExpectedResult: 2. No sepsis alert is triggered.

test_cases.description: Verify the exact thresholds and the 1-hour window boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record respiratory rate of exactly 24 breaths/min and oxygen saturation drop below of exactly 92 percent.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 24 breaths/min / 92 percent no sepsis alert triggers (values must strictly exceed).
ExpectedResult: 2. Outside the 1-hour window no sepsis alert triggers.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when only one factor exceeds its threshold.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record only respiratory rate above 24 breaths/min (with oxygen saturation drop below normal).

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only respiratory rate elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only oxygen saturation drop below elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.

requirement.text: The system SHALL require two-factor authentication for any user signing in from an IP address outside the imaging-suite VLAN, and SHALL grant access only after a valid second factor is supplied.

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 6 consecutive failed login attempts within a 15-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

test_cases.description: Verify the account locks after 6 consecutive failed logins within 15 minutes.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t615' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 6 consecutive failed login attempts for 'user.t615' within 15 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt a further login using the CORRECT password.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the 6th consecutive failure the account is locked.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied despite correct credentials and a lockout notice naming the account and lockout duration is shown.

test_cases.description: Verify a successful login before the threshold resets the counter.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t615' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 5 failed attempts, then log in with the correct password.
Step: 2. Log out and submit 5 further failed attempts.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the correct login the failed-attempt counter resets to 0.
ExpectedResult: 2. The account remains unlocked and no lockout notice appears, because no window contains 6 consecutive failures.

test_cases.description: Verify the 6-attempt / 15-minute boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t615' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit exactly 5 failed attempts within 15 minutes and inspect state.
Step: 2. Submit an 6th failed attempt at minute 14 and inspect state.
Step: 3. For a fresh account submit 5 failures, wait past minute 15, then submit one more.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 5 failures the account remains unlocked.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 6 failures within 15 minutes the account locks and the lockout notice appears.
ExpectedResult: 3. The final failure falls outside the 15-minute window, so the account remains unlocked.

requirement.text: The system SHALL automatically end a clinical session after 40 minutes without user input and SHALL require re-authentication before the chart can be accessed again.

ExpectedResult: 2. The chart is inaccessible and a re-authentication prompt is displayed; access is restored only after valid credentials.

test_cases.description: Verify input before the timeout keeps the session active.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx40' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 40 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for 39 minutes, then click within the chart.
Step: 2. Remain idle for a further 39 minutes, then click within the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The session remains active and no prompt appears.
ExpectedResult: 2. The session remains active because each input resets the inactivity timer.

test_cases.description: Verify the 40-minute inactivity boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx40' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 40 minutes; clock controllable.

Step: 2. Allow inactivity to reach exactly 40 minutes 0 seconds; inspect state.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Just under 40 minutes the session is still active.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 40 minutes the session ends and re-authentication is required.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's INR exceeds 4 ratio AND the patient's systolic blood pressure exceeds 90 mmHg within the same 6-hour window.

test_cases.description: Verify a sepsis alert triggers when both INR and systolic blood pressure exceed thresholds within 6 hours.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record INR of 6 ratio at 09:00.
Step: 2. Record systolic blood pressure of 92 mmHg within the same 6-hour window.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The INR is recorded.
ExpectedResult: 2. A sepsis alert is triggered and displayed for the patient.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when neither value exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record INR of -1 ratio.
Step: 2. Record systolic blood pressure of 88 mmHg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Both values are recorded below threshold.
ExpectedResult: 2. No sepsis alert is triggered.

test_cases.description: Verify the exact thresholds and the 6-hour window boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record INR of exactly 4 ratio and systolic blood pressure of exactly 90 mmHg.
Step: 2. Record both values above threshold but 6 hours and 1 minute apart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 4 ratio / 90 mmHg no sepsis alert triggers (values must strictly exceed).
ExpectedResult: 2. Outside the 6-hour window no sepsis alert triggers.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when only one factor exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record only INR above 4 ratio (with systolic blood pressure normal).
Step: 2. Separately record only systolic blood pressure above 90 mmHg (with INR normal).
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only INR elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only systolic blood pressure elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.

requirement.text:
The system SHALL display the estimated blood volume computed from weight and age on the patient header, rounded to 0 decimal place(s).

test_cases.description: Verify estimated blood volume is computed from weight and age and displayed.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a medication order when the ordered daily dose of Ciprofloxacin exceeds the formulary maximum daily dose of 1500 mg defined in the formulary, and SHALL display the formulary maximum daily dose in the rejection message.

test_cases.description: Verify a Ciprofloxacin order within the catalog dose ceiling is accepted.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary catalog dose ceiling for Ciprofloxacin is 1500 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> Medications and select Ciprofloxacin.
Step: 2. Enter a regimen totalling 750 mg per day.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The medication ordering screen is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The daily total of 750 mg is calculated and shown.
ExpectedResult: 3. The order is accepted and saved, within the catalog dose ceiling of 1500 mg.

test_cases.description: Verify a Ciprofloxacin order exceeding the catalog dose ceiling is rejected.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary catalog dose ceiling for Ciprofloxacin is 1500 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> Medications and select Ciprofloxacin.
Step: 2. Enter a regimen totalling 2250 mg per day.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The medication ordering screen is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The daily total of 2250 mg is calculated and shown.
ExpectedResult: 3. The order is rejected and is not saved.

test_cases.description: Verify the catalog dose ceiling boundary for Ciprofloxacin.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary catalog dose ceiling for Ciprofloxacin is 1500 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Order Ciprofloxacin totalling exactly 1500 mg per day and sign.
Step: 2. Order Ciprofloxacin totalling 1501 mg per day and sign.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 1500 mg the order is accepted, because the dose did not EXCEED the maximum.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 1501 mg the order is rejected.

test_cases.description: Verify the rejection message displays the catalog dose ceiling value.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary catalog dose ceiling for Ciprofloxacin is 1500 mg.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Order Ciprofloxacin totalling 2250 mg per day and attempt to sign.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The rejection message states the catalog dose ceiling of 1500 mg.

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 6 consecutive failed login attempts within a 20-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

test_cases.description: Verify the account locks after 6 consecutive failed logins within 20 minutes.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t620' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 6 consecutive failed login attempts for 'user.t620' within 20 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt a further login using the CORRECT password.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the 6th consecutive failure the account is locked.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied despite correct credentials and a lockout notice naming the account and lockout duration is shown.

test_cases.description: Verify a successful login before the threshold resets the counter.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t620' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 5 failed attempts, then log in with the correct password.
Step: 2. Log out and submit 5 further failed attempts.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the correct login the failed-attempt counter resets to 0.
ExpectedResult: 2. The account remains unlocked and no lockout notice appears, because no window contains 6 consecutive failures.

test_cases.description: Verify the 6-attempt / 20-minute boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t620' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit exactly 5 failed attempts within 20 minutes and inspect state.
Step: 2. Submit an 6th failed attempt at minute 19 and inspect state.
Step: 3. For a fresh account submit 5 failures, wait past minute 20, then submit one more.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 5 failures the account remains unlocked.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 6 failures within 20 minutes the account locks and the lockout notice appears.
ExpectedResult: 3. The final failure falls outside the 20-minute window, so the account remains unlocked.

requirement.text: The system SHALL automatically end a clinical session after 3 minutes without user input and SHALL require re-authentication before the chart can be accessed again.

test_cases.description: Verify a session ends after 3 minutes of no input and requires re-authentication.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx3' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 3 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient chart and leave the workstation idle for 3 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt to scroll the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 3 minutes of inactivity the session ends and the chart is hidden.
ExpectedResult: 2. The chart is inaccessible and a re-authentication prompt is displayed; access is restored only after valid credentials.

test_cases.description: Verify input before the timeout keeps the session active.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx3' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 3 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for 2 minutes, then click within the chart.
Step: 2. Remain idle for a further 2 minutes, then click within the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The session remains active and no prompt appears.
ExpectedResult: 2. The session remains active because each input resets the inactivity timer.

requirement.text: The system SHALL alert the ordering provider when two active medications (Ciprofloxacin and Tizanidine) have a known major drug-drug interaction, and the alert SHALL name both interacting medications.

test_cases.description: Verify a major drug-drug interaction alert is raised naming both medications.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Ciprofloxacin is shown as active.

test_cases.description: Verify the drug-drug interaction alert text names both interacting medications.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Ciprofloxacin + Tizanidine as a major interaction.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Trigger the Ciprofloxacin + Tizanidine interaction and inspect the alert text.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The alert text explicitly contains both 'Ciprofloxacin' and 'Tizanidine' by name.

requirement.text: The system SHALL restrict access to donor-recipient matching records to users holding the Transplant role and SHALL deny access to all other roles, recording each denied attempt in the audit log.

requirement.text: The system SHALL calculate a Prednisolone dose as 1 milligrams per kilogram of the patient's recorded body weight and SHALL round the calculated dose to 1 decimal place(s).

test_cases.description: Verify the Prednisolone dose is calculated as 1 mg/kg of recorded body weight.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The chart shows no recorded body weight.
ExpectedResult: 2. No dose is calculated; an error states a recorded weight is required and the order cannot be signed.

requirement.text: The system SHALL require a documented override reason of at least 15 characters when a provider dismisses a critical drug-interaction alert, and SHALL store the override reason with the order.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the critical drug-interaction alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of at least 15 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The critical drug-interaction alert is presented and a override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is accepted and the order is signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the alert cannot be dismissed with no override reason.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the critical drug-interaction alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Leave the override reason empty and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is rejected, a message requires a override reason, and the order is not signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the accepted override reason is stored with the order.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a critical drug-interaction alert.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Dismiss the critical drug-interaction alert with a valid override reason and open the signed order detail.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The stored order detail shows the exact override reason text that was entered.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a new patient registration when the supplied medical record number (MRN-Q) already exists in the system, and SHALL display the conflicting medical record number in the rejection message.

test_cases.description: Verify a new patient can be registered with a unique medical record number.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Seed the system with an existing medical record number 'MRN-Q-0002'.

test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The rejection message displays the conflicting medical record number 'MRN-Q-0002'.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's temperature exceeds 38 degrees Celsius AND the patient's systolic blood pressure exceeds 90 mmHg within the same 4-hour window.

test_cases.description: Verify a sepsis alert triggers when both temperature and systolic blood pressure exceed thresholds within 4 hours.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record temperature of 47 degrees Celsius at 09:00.
Step: 2. Record systolic blood pressure of 92 mmHg within the same 4-hour window.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The temperature is recorded.
ExpectedResult: 2. A sepsis alert is triggered and displayed for the patient.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when neither value exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record temperature of 33 degrees Celsius.
Step: 2. Record systolic blood pressure of 88 mmHg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Both values are recorded below threshold.
ExpectedResult: 2. No sepsis alert is triggered.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when only one factor exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record only temperature above 38 degrees Celsius (with systolic blood pressure normal).
Step: 2. Separately record only systolic blood pressure above 90 mmHg (with temperature normal).
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only temperature elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only systolic blood pressure elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.

requirement.text: The system SHALL allow a provider to place a nuclear-medicine order, SHALL allow selection of a collection priority of STAT or Routine, and SHALL print a specimen label containing the patient's MRN and the nuclear-medicine order ID.

test_cases.description: Verify the order cannot be signed without a collection priority.

Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> nuclear-medicine and select a test.
Step: 2. Leave the collection priority unselected.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A test is selectable.
ExpectedResult: 2. The order is rejected with a message requiring a priority of STAT or Routine, and no order is created.

test_cases.description: Verify Routine priority and the specimen label content.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient chart open.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Place the order with the collection priority 'Routine' and sign.
Step: 2. Inspect the printed specimen label.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The order is created with priority Routine.
ExpectedResult: 2. The specimen label contains the patient's MRN and the nuclear-medicine order ID.

requirement.text:

requirement.text: The system SHALL require two-factor authentication for any user signing in from an IP address outside the research-network segment, and SHALL grant access only after a valid second factor is supplied.

test_cases.description: Verify an invalid second factor denies access.

Step: 2. Enter an INVALID second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A two-factor authentication challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The invalid second factor is rejected and access is denied.

requirement.text: The system SHALL archive vital-sign readings older than 120 days to cold storage and SHALL keep archived readings retrievable within 10 seconds.

Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is listed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The reading is in active storage and has not been archived to cold storage.

test_cases.description: Verify the 120-day archival boundary.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 120 days the reading is still in active storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 121 days the reading has been archived to cold storage.

requirement.text: The system SHALL let a nurse document a medication administration of Insulin lispro 4 units, SHALL capture the administration time, and SHALL block a duplicate medication administration within 45 minutes of the previous one for the same medication.

test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is routed to the ordering provider's secure inbox, not to any other recipient.

test_cases.description: Verify a Azithromycin order exceeding the formulary maximum daily dose is rejected.

test_cases.description: Verify the formulary maximum daily dose boundary for Azithromycin.

test_cases.description: Verify the rejection message displays the formulary maximum daily dose value.

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 6 consecutive failed login attempts within a 30-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

test_cases.description: Verify the account locks after 6 consecutive failed logins within 30 minutes.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t630' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 6 consecutive failed login attempts for 'user.t630' within 30 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt a further login using the CORRECT password.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the 6th consecutive failure the account is locked.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied despite correct credentials and a lockout notice naming the account and lockout duration is shown.

test_cases.description: Verify a successful login before the threshold resets the counter.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t630' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 5 failed attempts, then log in with the correct password.
Step: 2. Log out and submit 5 further failed attempts.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the correct login the failed-attempt counter resets to 0.
ExpectedResult: 2. The account remains unlocked and no lockout notice appears, because no window contains 6 consecutive failures.

test_cases.description: Verify the 6-attempt / 30-minute boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t630' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit exactly 5 failed attempts within 30 minutes and inspect state.
Step: 2. Submit an 6th failed attempt at minute 29 and inspect state.
Step: 3. For a fresh account submit 5 failures, wait past minute 30, then submit one more.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 5 failures the account remains unlocked.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 6 failures within 30 minutes the account locks and the lockout notice appears.
ExpectedResult: 3. The final failure falls outside the 30-minute window, so the account remains unlocked.

requirement.text: The system SHALL automatically end a clinical session after 7 minutes without user input and SHALL require re-authentication before the chart can be accessed again.

test_cases.description: Verify a session ends after 7 minutes of no input and requires re-authentication.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx7' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 7 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient chart and leave the workstation idle for 7 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt to scroll the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 7 minutes of inactivity the session ends and the chart is hidden.
ExpectedResult: 2. The chart is inaccessible and a re-authentication prompt is displayed; access is restored only after valid credentials.

test_cases.description: Verify input before the timeout keeps the session active.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx7' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 7 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for 6 minutes, then click within the chart.
Step: 2. Remain idle for a further 6 minutes, then click within the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The session remains active and no prompt appears.
ExpectedResult: 2. The session remains active because each input resets the inactivity timer.

requirement.text: The system SHALL alert the ordering provider when two active medications (Rifampin and Warfarin) have a known major drug-drug interaction, and the alert SHALL name both interacting medications.

test_cases.description: Verify a major drug-drug interaction alert is raised naming both medications.

test_cases.expectedResults:

ExpectedResult: 2. A major drug-drug interaction alert is presented and the alert text names both Rifampin and Warfarin.

test_cases.description: Verify no alert is raised for a non-interacting pair.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Rifampin + Warfarin as a major interaction.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm the patient has an active medication with no known interaction with the ordered drug.
Step: 2. Order and sign a non-interacting medication.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The prior medication is active.
ExpectedResult: 2. The order is signed with no drug-drug interaction alert presented.

test_cases.description: Verify the drug-drug interaction alert text names both interacting medications.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Rifampin + Warfarin as a major interaction.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Trigger the Rifampin + Warfarin interaction and inspect the alert text.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The alert text explicitly contains both 'Rifampin' and 'Warfarin' by name.

requirement.text: The system SHALL restrict access to military-service health records to users holding the Veterans Care role and SHALL deny access to all other roles, recording each denied attempt in the audit log.

test_cases.expectedResults:

requirement.text: The system SHALL calculate a Ranitidine dose as 2 milligrams per kilogram of the patient's recorded body weight and SHALL round the calculated dose to 1 decimal place(s).

test_cases.description: Verify the Ranitidine dose is calculated as 2 mg/kg of recorded body weight.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Ranitidine dosing is 2 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm the recorded body weight is 12.0 kg.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Ranitidine dosing at 2 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded body weight of 12.0 kg is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The system calculates and displays a dose of 24.0 mg.

test_cases.description: Verify calculation is blocked when no recorded body weight is recorded.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Ranitidine dosing is 2 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient with NO recorded body weight.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Ranitidine dosing at 2 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The chart shows no recorded body weight.
ExpectedResult: 2. No dose is calculated; an error states a recorded weight is required and the order cannot be signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the calculated dose is rounded to 1 decimal place(s).

test_cases.expectedResults:
