ExpectedResult: 2. The displayed dose shows no more than 1 decimal place(s).

requirement.text: The system SHALL require a documented override reason of at least 15 characters when a provider dismisses a duplicate-therapy alert, and SHALL store the override reason with the order.

test_cases.description: Verify a duplicate-therapy alert can be dismissed with a sufficient override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a duplicate-therapy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the duplicate-therapy alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of at least 15 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The duplicate-therapy alert is presented and a override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is accepted and the order is signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the alert cannot be dismissed with no override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a duplicate-therapy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the duplicate-therapy alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Leave the override reason empty and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is rejected, a message requires a override reason, and the order is not signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 15-character minimum override reason boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a duplicate-therapy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Enter a override reason of 14 characters and confirm.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of exactly 15 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 14 characters the override is rejected, below the 15-character minimum.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 15 characters the override is accepted.

test_cases.description: Verify the accepted override reason is stored with the order.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a duplicate-therapy alert.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Dismiss the duplicate-therapy alert with a valid override reason and open the signed order detail.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The stored order detail shows the exact override reason text that was entered.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a new patient registration when the supplied medical record number (MRN-R) already exists in the system, and SHALL display the conflicting medical record number in the rejection message.

test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Attempt to register a patient with the duplicate patient index key 'MRN-R-0002'.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The rejection message displays the conflicting patient index key 'MRN-R-0002'.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's heart rate exceeds 90 bpm AND the patient's white blood cell count exceeds 12 10^9/L within the same 6-hour window.

test_cases.description: Verify a infection warning triggers when both heart rate and white blood cell count exceed thresholds within 6 hours.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record heart rate of 110 bpm at 09:00.
Step: 2. Record white blood cell count of 14 10^9/L within the same 6-hour window.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The heart rate is recorded.
ExpectedResult: 2. A infection warning is triggered and displayed for the patient.

test_cases.description: Verify no infection warning triggers when neither value exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record heart rate of 85 bpm.
Step: 2. Record white blood cell count of 10 10^9/L.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Both values are recorded below threshold.
ExpectedResult: 2. No infection warning is triggered.

test_cases.description: Verify the exact thresholds and the 6-hour window boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record heart rate of exactly 90 bpm and white blood cell count of exactly 12 10^9/L.
Step: 2. Record both values above threshold but 6 hours and 1 minute apart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 90 bpm / 12 10^9/L no infection warning triggers (values must strictly exceed).
ExpectedResult: 2. Outside the 6-hour window no infection warning triggers.

test_cases.description: Verify no infection warning triggers when only one factor exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record only heart rate above 90 bpm (with white blood cell count normal).
Step: 2. Separately record only white blood cell count above 12 10^9/L (with heart rate normal).
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only heart rate elevated, no infection warning triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only white blood cell count elevated, no infection warning triggers.

requirement.text: The system SHALL allow a provider to place a interventional-radiology order, SHALL allow selection of a collection priority of STAT or Routine, and SHALL print a specimen label containing the patient's MRN and the interventional-radiology order ID.

test_cases.description: Verify Routine priority and the specimen label content.

requirement.text:

requirement.text: The system SHALL require two-factor authentication for any user signing in from an IP address outside the lab-information subnet, and SHALL grant access only after a valid second factor is supplied.

Step: 1. From an IP outside the lab-information subnet, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter a valid second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The source IP is recognised as outside the lab-information subnet and a a secondary passphrase challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The valid second factor is accepted and access is granted.

test_cases.description: Verify an invalid second factor denies access.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in a secondary passphrase; workstation IP outside the lab-information subnet.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. From an IP outside the lab-information subnet, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter an INVALID second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A a secondary passphrase challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The invalid second factor is rejected and access is denied.

test_cases.description: Verify the the lab-information subnet boundary is enforced at the edge of the range.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in a secondary passphrase; workstation IP outside the lab-information subnet.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Sign in from the last address inside the lab-information subnet.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Inside the lab-information subnet no a secondary passphrase is required.
ExpectedResult: 2. Just outside the lab-information subnet a a secondary passphrase challenge is enforced.

requirement.text: The system SHALL archive vital-sign readings older than 180 days to cold storage and SHALL keep archived readings retrievable within 2 seconds.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Locate a vital-sign reading dated 210 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier and open it.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is reported as held in a deep archive vault.
ExpectedResult: 2. Its values are retrieved and displayed within 2 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify readings newer than 180 days are not archived to a deep archive vault.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Locate a vital-sign reading dated 120 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is listed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The reading is in active storage and has not been archived to a deep archive vault.

test_cases.description: Verify the 180-day archival boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Inspect a reading dated exactly 180 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect a reading dated exactly 181 days ago.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 180 days the reading is still in active storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 181 days the reading has been archived to a deep archive vault.

requirement.text: The system SHALL let a nurse document a medication administration of Furosemide 40 mg, SHALL capture the administration time, and SHALL block a duplicate medication administration within 45 minutes of the previous one for the same medication.

requirement.text: The system SHALL deliver a critical lab value notification for calcium to the ordering provider's secure inbox within 10 minutes of result verification.

test_cases.description: Verify the 10-minute delivery boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding calcium order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical calcium result and measure delivery latency to the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The abnormal result alert is recorded as delivered within 10 minutes of verification.

test_cases.description: Verify the notification routes to the ordering provider specifically.

test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical calcium result ordered by 'dr.t' and inspect the recipient.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The abnormal result alert is routed to the ordering provider's secure inbox, not to any other recipient.

requirement.text: The system SHALL transmit a signed prescription to the selected pharmacy within 150 seconds of signing and SHALL update the order status to 'Sent' upon receiving pharmacy confirmation.

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 7 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

test_cases.description: Verify the account locks after 7 consecutive failed logins within 10 minutes.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t710' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 7 consecutive failed login attempts for 'user.t710' within 10 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt a further login using the CORRECT password.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the 7th consecutive failure the account is locked.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied despite correct credentials and a lockout notice naming the account and lockout duration is shown.

test_cases.description: Verify a successful login before the threshold resets the counter.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t710' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 6 failed attempts, then log in with the correct password.
Step: 2. Log out and submit 6 further failed attempts.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the correct login the failed-attempt counter resets to 0.
ExpectedResult: 2. The account remains unlocked and no lockout notice appears, because no window contains 7 consecutive failures.

test_cases.description: Verify the 7-attempt / 10-minute boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t710' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit exactly 6 failed attempts within 10 minutes and inspect state.
Step: 2. Submit an 7th failed attempt at minute 9 and inspect state.
Step: 3. For a fresh account submit 6 failures, wait past minute 10, then submit one more.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 6 failures the account remains unlocked.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 7 failures within 10 minutes the account locks and the lockout notice appears.
ExpectedResult: 3. The final failure falls outside the 10-minute window, so the account remains unlocked.

requirement.text: The system SHALL automatically end a clinical session after 35 minutes without user input and SHALL require re-authentication before the chart can be accessed again.

test_cases.description: Verify a session ends after 35 minutes of no input and requires re-authentication.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx35' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 35 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient chart and leave the workstation idle for 35 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt to scroll the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 35 minutes of inactivity the session ends and the chart is hidden.
ExpectedResult: 2. The chart is inaccessible and a re-authentication prompt is displayed; access is restored only after valid credentials.

test_cases.description: Verify input before the timeout keeps the session active.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx35' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 35 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for 34 minutes, then click within the chart.
Step: 2. Remain idle for a further 34 minutes, then click within the chart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The session remains active and no prompt appears.
ExpectedResult: 2. The session remains active because each input resets the inactivity timer.

test_cases.description: Verify the 35-minute inactivity boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx35' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 35 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for exactly 35 minutes minus 1 second; inspect state.
Step: 2. Allow inactivity to reach exactly 35 minutes 0 seconds; inspect state.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Just under 35 minutes the session is still active.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 35 minutes the session ends and re-authentication is required.

requirement.text: The system SHALL alert the ordering provider when two active medications (Metformin and Contrast dye) have a known moderate drug-drug interaction, and the alert SHALL name both interacting medications.

test_cases.description: Verify a moderate drug-drug interaction alert is raised naming both medications.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Metformin + Contrast dye as a moderate interaction.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm Metformin is active for the test patient.
Step: 2. Order and sign Contrast dye for the patient.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Metformin is shown as active.
ExpectedResult: 2. A moderate drug-drug interaction alert is presented and the alert text names both Metformin and Contrast dye.

test_cases.description: Verify no alert is raised for a non-interacting pair.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Metformin + Contrast dye as a moderate interaction.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm the patient has an active medication with no known interaction with the ordered drug.
Step: 2. Order and sign a non-interacting medication.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The prior medication is active.
ExpectedResult: 2. The order is signed with no drug-drug interaction alert presented.

test_cases.description: Verify the drug-drug interaction alert text names both interacting medications.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; interaction database classifies Metformin + Contrast dye as a moderate interaction.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Trigger the Metformin + Contrast dye interaction and inspect the alert text.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The alert text explicitly contains both 'Metformin' and 'Contrast dye' by name.

requirement.text: The system SHALL restrict access to court-ordered evaluation notes to users holding the Forensic Psychiatry role and SHALL deny access to all other roles, recording each denied attempt in the audit log.

test_cases.description: Verify a Forensic Psychiatry role holder can open a court-ordered evaluation memos record.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'auth.t' holds the Forensic Psychiatry role; a court-ordered evaluation memos record exists for the test patient.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Log in as a user holding the Forensic Psychiatry role.
Step: 2. Open the patient's court-ordered evaluation memos.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Forensic Psychiatry role is active.
ExpectedResult: 2. The court-ordered evaluation memos opens and its content is displayed.

test_cases.description: Verify a user without the Forensic Psychiatry role is denied access.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'auth.t' holds the Forensic Psychiatry role; a court-ordered evaluation memos record exists for the test patient.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Log in as a user WITHOUT the Forensic Psychiatry role.
Step: 2. Attempt to open the court-ordered evaluation memos.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Login succeeds without the Forensic Psychiatry role.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied and no court-ordered evaluation memos content is displayed.

test_cases.description: Verify each denied attempt is recorded in the audit log.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'auth.t' holds the Forensic Psychiatry role; a court-ordered evaluation memos record exists for the test patient.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. As a non-Forensic Psychiatry role user attempt to open the court-ordered evaluation memos.
Step: 2. As an auditor query the audit log for denials.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Access is denied.
ExpectedResult: 2. An audit entry recording the denied attempt is present.

requirement.text: The system SHALL calculate a Metronidazole dose as 7 milligrams per kilogram of the patient's recorded body weight and SHALL round the calculated dose to 1 decimal place(s).

test_cases.description: Verify calculation is blocked when no recorded body weight is recorded.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Metronidazole dosing is 7 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient with NO recorded body weight.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Metronidazole dosing at 7 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The chart shows no recorded body weight.
ExpectedResult: 2. No dose is calculated; an error states a recorded weight is required and the order cannot be signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the calculated dose is rounded to 1 decimal place(s).
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Metronidazole dosing is 7 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Set the recorded body weight to 12.345 kg and select 7 mg/kg dosing.
Step: 2. Set the recorded body weight to 12.344 kg and repeat.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The displayed dose is 86.4 mg, rounded to 1 decimal place(s).
ExpectedResult: 2. The displayed dose shows no more than 1 decimal place(s).

requirement.text: The system SHALL require a documented override reason of at least 20 characters when a provider dismisses a high-severity allergy alert, and SHALL store the override reason with the order.

test_cases.description: Verify the alert cannot be dismissed with no override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a high-severity allergy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the high-severity allergy alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Leave the override reason empty and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is rejected, a message requires a override reason, and the order is not signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 20-character minimum override reason boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a high-severity allergy alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Enter a override reason of 19 characters and confirm.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of exactly 20 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 19 characters the override is rejected, below the 20-character minimum.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 20 characters the override is accepted.

test_cases.description: Verify the accepted override reason is stored with the order.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a high-severity allergy alert.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Dismiss the high-severity allergy alert with a valid override reason and open the signed order detail.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The stored order detail shows the exact override reason text that was entered.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a new patient registration when the supplied medical record number (MRN-S) already exists in the system, and SHALL display the conflicting medical record number in the rejection message.

test_cases.description: Verify a new patient can be registered with a unique medical record number.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; registration clerk logged in.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open Patient Registration -> New Patient.
Step: 2. Enter demographics with a unique medical record number 'MRN-S-0001'.
Step: 3. Click 'Register'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The registration form is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The patient is registered and the chart is created with medical record number 'MRN-S-0001'.

test_cases.description: Verify registration is rejected when the medical record number already exists.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; registration clerk logged in.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Seed the system with an existing medical record number 'MRN-S-0002'.
Step: 2. Register a new patient with the same medical record number 'MRN-S-0002'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The existing medical record number is present.
ExpectedResult: 2. The registration is rejected and no new patient record is created.

test_cases.description: Verify the rejection message displays the conflicting medical record number.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; registration clerk logged in.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Attempt to register a patient with the duplicate medical record number 'MRN-S-0002'.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The rejection message displays the conflicting medical record number 'MRN-S-0002'.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's lactate exceeds 4 mmol/L AND the patient's systolic blood pressure exceeds 90 mmHg within the same 3-hour window.

test_cases.description: Verify a sepsis alert triggers when both lactate and systolic blood pressure exceed thresholds within 3 hours.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record lactate of 6 mmol/L at 09:00.
Step: 2. Record systolic blood pressure of 92 mmHg within the same 3-hour window.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The lactate is recorded.
ExpectedResult: 2. A sepsis alert is triggered and displayed for the patient.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when neither value exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record lactate of -1 mmol/L.
Step: 2. Record systolic blood pressure of 88 mmHg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Both values are recorded below threshold.
ExpectedResult: 2. No sepsis alert is triggered.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when only one factor exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record only lactate above 4 mmol/L (with systolic blood pressure normal).
Step: 2. Separately record only systolic blood pressure above 90 mmHg (with lactate normal).
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only lactate elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only systolic blood pressure elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.

requirement.text: The system SHALL allow a provider to place a endoscopy order, SHALL allow selection of a collection priority of STAT or Routine, and SHALL print a specimen label containing the patient's MRN and the endoscopy order ID.

test_cases.description: Verify the order cannot be signed without a collection priority.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient chart open.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> endoscopy and select a test.
Step: 2. Leave the collection priority unselected.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A test is selectable.
ExpectedResult: 2. The order is rejected with a message requiring a priority of STAT or Routine, and no order is created.

test_cases.description: Verify Routine priority and the specimen label content.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient chart open.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Place the order with the collection priority 'Routine' and sign.
Step: 2. Inspect the printed specimen label.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The order is created with priority Routine.
ExpectedResult: 2. The specimen label contains the patient's MRN and the endoscopy order ID.

requirement.text:
The system SHALL display a 'Interpreter Required' banner on the patient header when the patient has an active interpreter-required order.

Context: this requirement applies to active interpreter-required orders only; non-active interpreter-required orders are covered elsewhere.

test_cases.description: Verify the 'Interpreter Required' banner appears for a patient with an active interpreter-required order.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; clinician logged in.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient with an active interpreter-required order.
Step: 2. Inspect the patient header.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The patient chart opens.
ExpectedResult: 2. The 'Interpreter Required' banner is displayed on the patient header.

test_cases.description: Verify the 'Interpreter Required' banner is absent when no active interpreter-required order exists.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; clinician logged in.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open a patient with no active interpreter-required order.
Step: 2. Inspect the patient header.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The patient chart opens.
ExpectedResult: 2. The 'Interpreter Required' banner is not displayed.

requirement.text: The system SHALL require two-factor authentication for any user signing in from an IP address outside the surgical-suite subnet, and SHALL grant access only after a valid second factor is supplied.

test_cases.description: Verify two-factor authentication is required and grants access from an external IP.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in two-factor authentication; workstation IP outside the surgical-suite subnet.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. From an IP outside the surgical-suite subnet, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter a valid second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The source IP is recognised as outside the surgical-suite subnet and a two-factor authentication challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The valid second factor is accepted and access is granted.

test_cases.description: Verify the the surgical-suite subnet boundary is enforced at the edge of the range.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in two-factor authentication; workstation IP outside the surgical-suite subnet.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Sign in from the last address inside the surgical-suite subnet.
Step: 2. Sign in from the first address outside the surgical-suite subnet.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Inside the surgical-suite subnet no two-factor authentication is required.
ExpectedResult: 2. Just outside the surgical-suite subnet a two-factor authentication challenge is enforced.

requirement.text: The system SHALL archive vital-sign readings older than 180 days to cold storage and SHALL keep archived readings retrievable within 5 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify readings older than 180 days are archived to cold storage and remain retrievable.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Locate a vital-sign reading dated 210 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier and open it.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is reported as held in cold storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. Its values are retrieved and displayed within 5 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify the 180-day archival boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; archive viewer accessible; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Inspect a reading dated exactly 180 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect a reading dated exactly 181 days ago.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 180 days the reading is still in active storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 181 days the reading has been archived to cold storage.

requirement.text: The system SHALL let a nurse document a medication administration of Acetaminophen 650 mg, SHALL capture the administration time, and SHALL block a duplicate medication administration within 45 minutes of the previous one for the same medication.

test_cases.description: Verify a nurse can document a medication administration of Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open the Medication Administration Record.
Step: 2. Select the active Acetaminophen 650 mg order and document the administration.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Medication Administration Record is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The medication administration is documented and Acetaminophen 650 mg is shown as administered.

test_cases.description: Verify a duplicate medication administration within 45 minutes is blocked.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Given Acetaminophen 650 mg was administered 5 minutes ago, select the same order.
Step: 2. Attempt a second administration and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Acetaminophen 650 mg order is selectable.
ExpectedResult: 2. The second administration is blocked citing the duplicate within 45 minutes, and no second record is written.

test_cases.description: Verify the 45-minute duplicate boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Attempt a second medication administration at exactly 45 minutes after the first.
Step: 2. Attempt a second medication administration at 45 minutes minus 1 second after the first.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 45 minutes the administration is accepted.
ExpectedResult: 2. Just under 45 minutes the administration is blocked.

test_cases.description: Verify the administration time is captured and persisted.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Acetaminophen 650 mg.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Document a medication administration and open the recorded entry.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded entry stores the administration time.

requirement.text: The system SHALL deliver a critical lab value notification for potassium to the ordering provider's secure inbox within 15 minutes of result verification.

test_cases.description: Verify a critical lab value notification for potassium is delivered within 15 minutes of verification.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding potassium order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Verify a critical potassium result and record the verification time.
Step: 2. Open the secure inbox and record the notification arrival time.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The critical potassium result is verified.
ExpectedResult: 2. A critical lab value notification is present in the secure inbox and the interval is at or under 15 minutes.

test_cases.description: Verify duplicate verification events do not create a second notification.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding potassium order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Emit the same verified potassium result twice.
Step: 2. Inspect the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The result is verified twice.
ExpectedResult: 2. Exactly one critical lab value notification is present in the secure inbox; the duplicate is suppressed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 15-minute delivery boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding potassium order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical potassium result and measure delivery latency to the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is recorded as delivered within 15 minutes of verification.

test_cases.description: Verify the notification routes to the ordering provider specifically.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding potassium order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical potassium result ordered by 'dr.t' and inspect the recipient.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is routed to the ordering provider's secure inbox, not to any other recipient.

requirement.text: The system SHALL transmit a signed prescription to the selected pharmacy within 200 seconds of signing and SHALL update the order status to 'Sent' upon receiving pharmacy confirmation.

test_cases.description: Verify a signed prescription is transmitted to the selected pharmacy.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test pharmacy 'Riverside #2' configured to confirm receipt.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Select a medication and destination pharmacy.
Step: 2. Click 'Sign & Send' and observe transmission.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The pharmacy is selected.
ExpectedResult: 2. The signed prescription is transmitted to the selected pharmacy.

test_cases.description: Verify status does not become 'Sent' when the pharmacy is unreachable.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test pharmacy 'Riverside #2' configured to confirm receipt.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Disable the pharmacy endpoint.
Step: 2. Sign and send a prescription and observe status.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The endpoint is unreachable.
ExpectedResult: 2. Transmission fails, an error is shown, and the status does NOT become 'Sent'.

test_cases.description: Verify transmission occurs within the 200-second limit.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test pharmacy 'Riverside #2' configured to confirm receipt.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Sign a signed prescription and record the signing time.
Step: 2. Record the arrival time at the pharmacy interface.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The elapsed interval between signing and arrival is at or under 200 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify the order status updates to 'Sent' upon pharmacy confirmation.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test pharmacy 'Riverside #2' configured to confirm receipt.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Transmit a prescription and have the pharmacy return confirmation.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. On pharmacy confirmation the order status updates to 'Sent'.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a medication order when the ordered daily dose of Atorvastatin exceeds the formulary maximum daily dose of 80 mg defined in the formulary, and SHALL display the formulary maximum daily dose in the rejection message.

test_cases.description: Verify a Atorvastatin order within the formulary maximum daily dose is accepted.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary formulary maximum daily dose for Atorvastatin is 80 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> Medications and select Atorvastatin.
Step: 2. Enter a regimen totalling 40 mg per day.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The medication ordering screen is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The daily total of 40 mg is calculated and shown.
ExpectedResult: 3. The order is accepted and saved, within the formulary maximum daily dose of 80 mg.

test_cases.description: Verify a Atorvastatin order exceeding the formulary maximum daily dose is rejected.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary formulary maximum daily dose for Atorvastatin is 80 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Navigate to Orders -> Medications and select Atorvastatin.
Step: 2. Enter a regimen totalling 120 mg per day.
Step: 3. Click 'Sign & Send'.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The medication ordering screen is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The daily total of 120 mg is calculated and shown.
ExpectedResult: 3. The order is rejected and is not saved.

test_cases.description: Verify the formulary maximum daily dose boundary for Atorvastatin.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary formulary maximum daily dose for Atorvastatin is 80 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Order Atorvastatin totalling exactly 80 mg per day and sign.
Step: 2. Order Atorvastatin totalling 81 mg per day and sign.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 80 mg the order is accepted, because the dose did not EXCEED the maximum.

test_cases.description: Verify the rejection message displays the formulary maximum daily dose value.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; formulary formulary maximum daily dose for Atorvastatin is 80 mg.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Order Atorvastatin totalling 120 mg per day and attempt to sign.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The rejection message states the formulary maximum daily dose of 80 mg.

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 7 consecutive failed login attempts within a 15-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the 7th consecutive failure the account is locked.

test_cases.description: Verify a successful login before the threshold resets the counter.

test_cases.steps:

test_cases.expectedResults:

test_cases.description: Verify input before the timeout keeps the session active.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx50' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 50 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The session remains active and no prompt appears.
ExpectedResult: 2. The session remains active because each input resets the inactivity timer.

test_cases.description: Verify the 50-minute inactivity boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.sx50' logged in with a patient chart open; session timeout 50 minutes; clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Remain idle for exactly 50 minutes minus 1 second; inspect state.
Step: 2. Allow inactivity to reach exactly 50 minutes 0 seconds; inspect state.
test_cases.expectedResults:

test_cases.description: Verify no alert is raised for a non-interacting pair.

test_cases.expectedResults:

requirement.text: The system SHALL restrict access to fertility treatment records to users holding the Reproductive Endocrinology role and SHALL deny access to all other roles, recording each denied attempt in the audit log.

test_cases.description: Verify a Reproductive Endocrinology role holder can open a fertility treatment records record.

requirement.text: The system SHALL calculate a Azithromycin dose as 10 milligrams per kilogram of the patient's recorded body weight and SHALL round the calculated dose to 1 decimal place(s).

test_cases.description: Verify the Azithromycin dose is calculated as 10 mg/kg of recorded body weight.

Step: 1. Confirm the recorded body weight is 12.0 kg.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Azithromycin dosing at 10 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded body weight of 12.0 kg is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The system calculates and displays a dose of 120.0 mg.

test_cases.description: Verify the calculated dose is rounded to 1 decimal place(s).

Step: 1. Set the recorded body weight to 12.345 kg and select 10 mg/kg dosing.
Step: 2. Set the recorded body weight to 12.344 kg and repeat.

requirement.text: The system SHALL require a documented override reason of at least 20 characters when a provider dismisses a hard-stop dosing alert, and SHALL store the override reason with the order.

test_cases.description: Verify a hard-stop dosing alert can be dismissed with a sufficient override reason.

test_cases.expectedResults:

ExpectedResult: 2. The override is accepted and the order is signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 20-character minimum override reason boundary.

test_cases.steps:

Step: 2. Enter a override reason of exactly 20 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 19 characters the override is rejected, below the 20-character minimum.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 20 characters the override is accepted.

test_cases.description: Verify the accepted override reason is stored with the order.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a hard-stop dosing alert.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Dismiss the hard-stop dosing alert with a valid override reason and open the signed order detail.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The stored order detail shows the exact override reason text that was entered.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a new patient registration when the supplied medical record number (MRN-T) already exists in the system, and SHALL display the conflicting medical record number in the rejection message.

test_cases.description: Verify a new patient can be registered with a unique medical record number.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's heart rate exceeds 90 bpm AND the patient's respiratory rate exceeds 20 breaths/min within the same 4-hour window.

test_cases.description: Verify a sepsis alert triggers when both heart rate and respiratory rate exceed thresholds within 4 hours.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record heart rate of 110 bpm at 09:00.
Step: 2. Record respiratory rate of 22 breaths/min within the same 4-hour window.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The heart rate is recorded.
ExpectedResult: 2. A sepsis alert is triggered and displayed for the patient.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when neither value exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record heart rate of 85 bpm.
Step: 2. Record respiratory rate of 18 breaths/min.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Both values are recorded below threshold.
ExpectedResult: 2. No sepsis alert is triggered.

test_cases.description: Verify the exact thresholds and the 4-hour window boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record heart rate of exactly 90 bpm and respiratory rate of exactly 20 breaths/min.
Step: 2. Record both values above threshold but 4 hours and 1 minute apart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 90 bpm / 20 breaths/min no sepsis alert triggers (values must strictly exceed).
ExpectedResult: 2. Outside the 4-hour window no sepsis alert triggers.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when only one factor exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record only heart rate above 90 bpm (with respiratory rate normal).
Step: 2. Separately record only respiratory rate above 20 breaths/min (with heart rate normal).
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only heart rate elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only respiratory rate elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.

requirement.text: The system SHALL allow a provider to place a biopsy order, SHALL allow selection of a collection priority of STAT or Routine, and SHALL print a specimen label containing the patient's MRN and the biopsy order ID.

test_cases.description: Verify a provider can place a biopsy order with STAT priority.

Step: 2. Leave the collection priority unselected.

test_cases.expectedResults:

requirement.text:

requirement.text: The system SHALL require two-factor authentication for any user signing in from an IP address outside the outpatient-clinic range, and SHALL grant access only after a valid second factor is supplied.

test_cases.description: Verify two-factor authentication is required and grants access from an external IP.

Step: 2. Enter a valid second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The source IP is recognised as outside the outpatient-clinic range and a two-factor authentication challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The valid second factor is accepted and access is granted.

test_cases.description: Verify an invalid second factor denies access.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in two-factor authentication; workstation IP outside the outpatient-clinic range.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. From an IP outside the outpatient-clinic range, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter an INVALID second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A two-factor authentication challenge is presented.

test_cases.description: Verify the the outpatient-clinic range boundary is enforced at the edge of the range.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Sign in from the last address inside the outpatient-clinic range.
Step: 2. Sign in from the first address outside the outpatient-clinic range.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Inside the outpatient-clinic range no two-factor authentication is required.
ExpectedResult: 2. Just outside the outpatient-clinic range a two-factor authentication challenge is enforced.

requirement.text: The system SHALL archive vital-sign readings older than 180 days to cold storage and SHALL keep archived readings retrievable within 10 seconds.

test_cases.description: Verify the 180-day archival boundary.

Step: 1. Inspect a reading dated exactly 180 days ago.
Step: 2. Inspect a reading dated exactly 181 days ago.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 180 days the reading is still in active storage.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 181 days the reading has been archived to cold storage.

requirement.text: The system SHALL let a nurse document a medication administration of Heparin 5000 units, SHALL capture the administration time, and SHALL block a duplicate medication administration within 45 minutes of the previous one for the same medication.

test_cases.description: Verify a nurse can document a medication administration of Heparin 5000 units.

Step: 1. Open the Medication Administration Record.
Step: 2. Select the active Heparin 5000 units order and document the administration.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Medication Administration Record is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The medication administration is documented and Heparin 5000 units is shown as administered.

test_cases.description: Verify a duplicate medication administration within 45 minutes is blocked.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Heparin 5000 units.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Given Heparin 5000 units was administered 5 minutes ago, select the same order.
Step: 2. Attempt a second administration and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Heparin 5000 units order is selectable.
ExpectedResult: 2. The second administration is blocked citing the duplicate within 45 minutes, and no second record is written.

test_cases.description: Verify the 45-minute duplicate boundary.

test_cases.expectedResults:

ExpectedResult: 2. Just under 45 minutes the administration is blocked.

test_cases.description: Verify the administration time is captured and persisted.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Heparin 5000 units.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Document a medication administration and open the recorded entry.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded entry stores the administration time.

requirement.text: The system SHALL deliver a critical lab value notification for troponin to the ordering provider's secure inbox within 15 minutes of result verification.

test_cases.description: Verify a critical lab value notification for troponin is delivered within 15 minutes of verification.

Step: 2. Open the secure inbox and record the notification arrival time.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The critical troponin result is verified.
ExpectedResult: 2. A critical lab value notification is present in the secure inbox and the interval is at or under 15 minutes.

test_cases.description: Verify duplicate verification events do not create a second notification.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding troponin order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Emit the same verified troponin result twice.
Step: 2. Inspect the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The result is verified twice.
ExpectedResult: 2. Exactly one critical lab value notification is present in the secure inbox; the duplicate is suppressed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 15-minute delivery boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding troponin order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical troponin result and measure delivery latency to the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is recorded as delivered within 15 minutes of verification.

test_cases.description: Verify the notification routes to the ordering provider specifically.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding troponin order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical troponin result ordered by 'dr.t' and inspect the recipient.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is routed to the ordering provider's secure inbox, not to any other recipient.

requirement.text: The system SHALL transmit a signed prescription to the selected pharmacy within 80 seconds of signing and SHALL update the order status to 'Sent' upon receiving pharmacy confirmation.

test_cases.description: Verify a signed prescription is transmitted to the selected pharmacy.

Step: 2. Click 'Sign & Send' and observe transmission.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The pharmacy is selected.

test_cases.expectedResults:

test_cases.description: Verify transmission occurs within the 80-second limit.

test_cases.description: Verify the order status updates to 'Sent' upon pharmacy confirmation.

test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Transmit a prescription and have the pharmacy return confirmation.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. On pharmacy confirmation the order status updates to 'Sent'.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a medication order when the ordered daily dose of Omeprazole exceeds the formulary maximum daily dose of 40 mg defined in the formulary, and SHALL display the formulary maximum daily dose in the rejection message.

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 7 consecutive failed login attempts within a 20-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

requirement.text: The system SHALL automatically end a clinical session after 22 minutes without user input and SHALL require re-authentication before the chart can be accessed again.

test_cases.description: Verify the 22-minute inactivity boundary.

test_cases.expectedResults:

ExpectedResult: 2. An audit entry recording the denied attempt is present.

requirement.text: The system SHALL calculate a Fentanyl dose as 0.001 milligrams per kilogram of the patient's recorded body weight and SHALL round the calculated dose to 3 decimal place(s).

test_cases.description: Verify the Fentanyl dose is calculated as 0.001 mg/kg of recorded body weight.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Fentanyl dosing is 0.001 mg/kg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Confirm the recorded body weight is 12.0 kg.
Step: 2. Select weight-based Fentanyl dosing at 0.001 mg/kg.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded body weight of 12.0 kg is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The system calculates and displays a dose of 0.012 mg.

test_cases.description: Verify calculation is blocked when no recorded body weight is recorded.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; pediatric patient with a recorded body weight; Fentanyl dosing is 0.001 mg/kg.

test_cases.expectedResults:

requirement.text: The system SHALL require a documented override reason of at least 20 characters when a provider dismisses a critical drug-interaction alert, and SHALL store the override reason with the order.

test_cases.description: Verify a critical drug-interaction alert can be dismissed with a sufficient override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a critical drug-interaction alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the critical drug-interaction alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of at least 20 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The critical drug-interaction alert is presented and a override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is accepted and the order is signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the alert cannot be dismissed with no override reason.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a critical drug-interaction alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Trigger the critical drug-interaction alert and choose to override.
Step: 2. Leave the override reason empty and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A override reason field is shown.
ExpectedResult: 2. The override is rejected, a message requires a override reason, and the order is not signed.

test_cases.description: Verify the 20-character minimum override reason boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a critical drug-interaction alert.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Enter a override reason of 19 characters and confirm.
Step: 2. Enter a override reason of exactly 20 characters and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 19 characters the override is rejected, below the 20-character minimum.
ExpectedResult: 2. At exactly 20 characters the override is accepted.

test_cases.description: Verify the accepted override reason is stored with the order.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider logged in; test patient triggers a critical drug-interaction alert.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Dismiss the critical drug-interaction alert with a valid override reason and open the signed order detail.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The stored order detail shows the exact override reason text that was entered.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a new patient registration when the supplied medical record number (MRN-U) already exists in the system, and SHALL display the conflicting medical record number in the rejection message.

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's temperature exceeds 38 degrees Celsius AND the patient's heart rate exceeds 90 bpm within the same 8-hour window.

test_cases.description: Verify a sepsis alert triggers when both temperature and heart rate exceed thresholds within 8 hours.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record temperature of 47 degrees Celsius at 09:00.
Step: 2. Record heart rate of 92 bpm within the same 8-hour window.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The temperature is recorded.
ExpectedResult: 2. A sepsis alert is triggered and displayed for the patient.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when neither value exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record temperature of 33 degrees Celsius.
Step: 2. Record heart rate of 88 bpm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Both values are recorded below threshold.
ExpectedResult: 2. No sepsis alert is triggered.

test_cases.description: Verify the exact thresholds and the 8-hour window boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record temperature of exactly 38 degrees Celsius and heart rate of exactly 90 bpm.
Step: 2. Record both values above threshold but 8 hours and 1 minute apart.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 38 degrees Celsius / 90 bpm no sepsis alert triggers (values must strictly exceed).
ExpectedResult: 2. Outside the 8-hour window no sepsis alert triggers.

test_cases.description: Verify no sepsis alert triggers when only one factor exceeds its threshold.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test patient admitted; vitals entry available.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Record only temperature above 38 degrees Celsius (with heart rate normal).
Step: 2. Separately record only heart rate above 90 bpm (with temperature normal).
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. With only temperature elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.
ExpectedResult: 2. With only heart rate elevated, no sepsis alert triggers.

requirement.text: The system SHALL allow a provider to place a coagulation order, SHALL allow selection of a collection priority of STAT or Routine, and SHALL print a specimen label containing the patient's MRN and the coagulation order ID.

test_cases.expectedResults:

requirement.text:
The system SHALL display a 'MRI Unsafe' banner on the patient header when the patient has an active MRI-unsafe-implant order.

requirement.text: The system SHALL require two-factor authentication for any user signing in from an IP address outside the radiology reading-room VLAN, and SHALL grant access only after a valid second factor is supplied.

test_cases.description: Verify a secondary passphrase is required and grants access from an external IP.

test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. From an IP outside the radiology reading-room VLAN, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter a valid second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The source IP is recognised as outside the radiology reading-room VLAN and a a secondary passphrase challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The valid second factor is accepted and access is granted.

test_cases.description: Verify an invalid second factor denies access.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in a secondary passphrase; workstation IP outside the radiology reading-room VLAN.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. From an IP outside the radiology reading-room VLAN, enter valid credentials.
Step: 2. Enter an INVALID second factor code.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. A a secondary passphrase challenge is presented.
ExpectedResult: 2. The invalid second factor is rejected and access is denied.

test_cases.description: Verify the the radiology reading-room VLAN boundary is enforced at the edge of the range.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; user 'dr.ext' enrolled in a secondary passphrase; workstation IP outside the radiology reading-room VLAN.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Sign in from the last address inside the radiology reading-room VLAN.
Step: 2. Sign in from the first address outside the radiology reading-room VLAN.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. Inside the radiology reading-room VLAN no a secondary passphrase is required.
ExpectedResult: 2. Just outside the radiology reading-room VLAN a a secondary passphrase challenge is enforced.

requirement.text: The system SHALL archive vital-sign readings older than 270 days to cold storage and SHALL keep archived readings retrievable within 2 seconds.

Step: 2. Inspect its storage tier.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The reading is listed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The reading is in active storage and has not been archived to cold storage.

test_cases.description: Verify the 270-day archival boundary.

Step: 2. Inspect a reading dated exactly 271 days ago.
test_cases.expectedResults:

requirement.text: The system SHALL let a nurse document a medication administration of Ondansetron 4 mg, SHALL capture the administration time, and SHALL block a duplicate medication administration within 60 minutes of the previous one for the same medication.

test_cases.description: Verify a nurse can document a medication administration of Ondansetron 4 mg.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Ondansetron 4 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Open the Medication Administration Record.
Step: 2. Select the active Ondansetron 4 mg order and document the administration.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Medication Administration Record is displayed.
ExpectedResult: 2. The medication administration is documented and Ondansetron 4 mg is shown as administered.

test_cases.description: Verify a duplicate medication administration within 60 minutes is blocked.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Ondansetron 4 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Given Ondansetron 4 mg was administered 5 minutes ago, select the same order.
Step: 2. Attempt a second administration and confirm.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The Ondansetron 4 mg order is selectable.
ExpectedResult: 2. The second administration is blocked citing the duplicate within 60 minutes, and no second record is written.

test_cases.description: Verify the 60-minute duplicate boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Ondansetron 4 mg.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Attempt a second medication administration at exactly 60 minutes after the first.
Step: 2. Attempt a second medication administration at 60 minutes minus 1 second after the first.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At exactly 60 minutes the administration is accepted.
ExpectedResult: 2. Just under 60 minutes the administration is blocked.

test_cases.description: Verify the administration time is captured and persisted.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; nurse 'nurse.t' logged in; test patient has an active order for Ondansetron 4 mg.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Document a medication administration and open the recorded entry.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The recorded entry stores the administration time.

requirement.text: The system SHALL deliver a critical lab value notification for hemoglobin to the ordering provider's secure inbox within 15 minutes of result verification.

test_cases.description: Verify the 15-minute delivery boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding hemoglobin order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical hemoglobin result and measure delivery latency to the secure inbox.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is recorded as delivered within 15 minutes of verification.

test_cases.description: Verify the notification routes to the ordering provider specifically.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; provider 'dr.t' has an outstanding hemoglobin order; secure inbox accessible.
test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Verify a critical hemoglobin result ordered by 'dr.t' and inspect the recipient.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. The critical lab value notification is routed to the ordering provider's secure inbox, not to any other recipient.

requirement.text: The system SHALL transmit a signed prescription to the selected pharmacy within 110 seconds of signing and SHALL update the order status to 'Sent' upon receiving pharmacy confirmation.

test_cases.description: Verify a signed prescription is transmitted to the selected pharmacy.

test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. The endpoint is unreachable.

test_cases.description: Verify transmission occurs within the 110-second limit.

Step: 1. Sign a signed prescription and record the signing time.
Step: 2. Record the arrival time at the pharmacy interface.

test_cases.description: Verify the order status updates to 'Sent' upon pharmacy confirmation.

test_cases.steps: Step: 1. Transmit a prescription and have the pharmacy return confirmation.
test_cases.expectedResults: ExpectedResult: 1. On pharmacy confirmation the order status updates to 'Sent'.

requirement.text: The system SHALL reject a medication order when the ordered daily dose of Tramadol exceeds the formulary maximum daily dose of 400 mg defined in the formulary, and SHALL display the formulary maximum daily dose in the rejection message.

requirement.text: The system SHALL lock a user account after 7 consecutive failed login attempts within a 30-minute window and SHALL display a lockout notice naming the account and the lockout duration.

test_cases.description: Verify the account locks after 7 consecutive failed logins within 30 minutes.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t730' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 7 consecutive failed login attempts for 'user.t730' within 30 minutes.
Step: 2. Attempt a further login using the CORRECT password.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the 7th consecutive failure the account is locked.
ExpectedResult: 2. Access is denied despite correct credentials and a lockout notice naming the account and lockout duration is shown.

test_cases.description: Verify a successful login before the threshold resets the counter.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t730' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit 6 failed attempts, then log in with the correct password.
Step: 2. Log out and submit 6 further failed attempts.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. After the correct login the failed-attempt counter resets to 0.
ExpectedResult: 2. The account remains unlocked and no lockout notice appears, because no window contains 7 consecutive failures.

test_cases.description: Verify the 7-attempt / 30-minute boundary.
test_cases.setup: HealthCore EHR test environment; test account 'user.t730' active and unlocked; system clock controllable.
test_cases.steps:
Step: 1. Submit exactly 6 failed attempts within 30 minutes and inspect state.
Step: 2. Submit an 7th failed attempt at minute 29 and inspect state.
Step: 3. For a fresh account submit 6 failures, wait past minute 30, then submit one more.
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult: 1. At 6 failures the account remains unlocked.
ExpectedResult: 2. At 7 failures within 30 minutes the account locks and the lockout notice appears.
ExpectedResult: 3. The final failure falls outside the 30-minute window, so the account remains unlocked.

requirement.text: The system SHALL automatically end a clinical session after 28 minutes without user input and SHALL require re-authentication before the chart can be accessed again.

test_cases.description: Verify input before the timeout keeps the session active.

requirement.text: The system SHALL calculate a Ketamine dose as 1 milligrams per kilogram of the patient's recorded body weight and SHALL round the calculated dose to 1 decimal place(s).

test_cases.steps:

requirement.text: The system SHALL trigger a sepsis alert when a patient's potassium exceeds 6 mmol/L AND the patient's heart rate exceeds 120 bpm within the same 2-hour window.

test_cases.expectedResults:

ExpectedResult: 2. With only heart rate elevated, no infection warning triggers.
